papers.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.authors: Junchao Huang, Guian Fang, Shengju Qian, Xianghao Kong, Zhuoran Zhao, Wei Huang, Yihua Du, Zixin Zhang, Justin Cui, Yuchao Gu, Yukang Chen, Xinting Hu, Tianyu He, Shaoshuai Shi, Zhuotao Tian, Xin Wang, Mike Zheng Shou, Li Jiang
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, autonomous driving, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: CUHK-SZ, SLAI, NUS, CUHK, HKUST, HKUST-GZ, NVIDIA, UCLA, MSRA
papers.intro: SolarWM提出了一个完全开放的交互式视频世界模型基础框架，通过可重构的多源数据引擎和骨干原生适配框架，在统一的三阶段训练协议下训练了四个5B-33B规模的模型，仅基于5秒序列训练即可实现分钟到小时级别的开放时程交互式推演。

papers.title: Thinking in Pictures: A Systematic Benchmark for Reasoning-driven Image Generation
papers.authors: Yutong Liu, Nan Huang, Xu Cao, James M. Rehg
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; New York University
papers.intro: 本文提出了RIG-BENCH——首个系统性地评估推理驱动图像生成能力的综合基准，包含2000个精心策划的样本，覆盖概念推理、变换推理、模式与结构推理、场景推理四大任务族，揭示了当前最先进生成模型在逻辑视觉推理方面的显著"推理-生成鸿沟"。

papers.title: PlantC2USeg: Cross-Scale Consistent Pre-Training for Few-Shot Unified Plant Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.authors: Yu Tian, Xintong Jiang, Jan Franklin Adamowski, Shiv O. Prasher, Shangpeng Sun
papers.tags: point cloud, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: McGill University
papers.intro: PlantC2USeg提出了一种结合跨尺度一致性学习和信息受限解码策略的深度迁移学习框架，通过自监督预训练实现少样本条件下跨物种、跨传感器的统一植物点云语义与实例分割。

papers.title: MuyBridge: Mobile Human Center-of-Mass Estimation from Monocular Video via Sparse Fusion
papers.authors: Aidan Bradshaw, Marco Giordano, David Rode, Andreas Habersack, Elif Basokur, Annika Kruse, Markus Tilp, Michele Magno, Peter Wolf, Luca Benini, Christoph Leitner
papers.tags: pose estimation, edge deployment, depth estimation, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: ETH Zurich, University of Graz, University of Bologna
papers.intro: MuyBridge是一个端侧系统，通过将紧凑的2D姿态网络与蒸馏的单步单目深度网络相结合，利用解剖学和物理学先验进行解析度量融合，在无需3D或任务特定监督的情况下，从单部手机摄像头视频流中实时估计运动员的分段质心轨迹。

papers.title: RoGe: Novel View Synthesis via End-to-End Implicit Reconstruction and Generation
papers.authors: Xiaolei Lang, Ze Kang, Zehao Huang, Naiyan Wang
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction, NeRF
papers.affiliations: Xiaomi EV（小米汽车）；Northeastern University（东北大学）
papers.intro: RoGe提出了一种端到端的重建与生成统一框架，通过将前馈重建网络产生的隐式场景表示以射线查询方式提取几何特征，直接注入视频扩散模型作为条件，消除了显式3D中间表示这一"有损桥梁"，使生成目标能够直接塑造自身的几何条件。

papers.title: GDB-Reward: From Evaluation Metrics to Training Rewards for Graphic Design
papers.authors: Adrienne Deganutti, Purvanshi Mehta, Simon Hadfield, Andrew Gilbert
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, OCR, YOLO
papers.affiliations: Lica World, University of Surrey
papers.intro: 本文提出GDB-Reward框架，将异构的图形设计评估指标系统地转化为统一的强化学习奖励，通过GRPO优化轻量级LoRA适配器来学习提示策略，在保持图像生成器完全冻结的情况下显著提升设计规范遵循度。

papers.title: Multi-Tool Image Editing Attribution in Facial Forgery
papers.authors: Sheng Liu, Qiang Sheng, Danding Wang, Yu Li, Chenming Zhou, Juan Cao
papers.tags: image classification, image generation, image retrieval
papers.affiliations: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文首次提出多工具图像编辑归因任务（MIEA），构建了包含50万+编辑人脸图像的大规模数据集MultiEdit，并设计了DPEC方法，通过双域分块特征增强和基于错误的课程学习策略，从空间和频域捕获可区分、局部感知的编辑工具痕迹，实现对最多五步编辑图像中所有参与工具的准确识别。

papers.title: RVSD: Retrieval Vision Sparse Decoding for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Canjie Liu, Jiawen Kang, Jinbo Wen, Zishao Zhong
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: 广东工业大学自动化学院、香港城市大学计算机科学系、广州中医药大学第二附属医院
papers.intro: RVSD提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的解码框架，首次将token稀疏化与语义空间视觉检索（SSVR）统一在单次解码过程中，通过将剪除的视觉token转化为可检索的记忆库并在需要时按需恢复视觉证据，从而在保持推理效率的同时有效缓解视觉幻觉。

papers.title: MV-dVRK: A Multi-Viewpoint Benchmark for Spatial Surgical Perception
papers.authors: Guido Caccianiga, Sergey Prokudin, Yutong Chen, Bernard Javot, Rachael L'Orsa, Omer Burak Aladağ, Yarden Sharon, Jens Rolinger, Ivan Capobianco, Anton Deguet, Siyu Tang, Katherine J. Kuchenbecker
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, medical image, autonomous driving, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, ETH Zürich, Erbe Group, Tübingen University Hospital, Johns Hopkins University
papers.intro: 本文提出了MV-dVRK——首个结合多个曝光同步立体视角、精确表面几何和相机位姿的离体手术多视角基准数据集，并系统比较了单目、立体、多立体和多视角3D重建方法在稀疏视角下的性能。

papers.title: Generating Medical Image Counterfactuals using Causal Explanations
papers.authors: David A. Kelly, Tom Yaacov, Nathan Blake, Sander Beckers, Hana Chockler
papers.tags: medical image, image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: King's College London（David A. Kelly, Tom Yaacov, Nathan Blake, Hana Chockler）；University College London（Sander Beckers）
papers.intro: 该论文提出了一种无需生成模型的医学图像反事实生成框架，通过直接从分类器自身的因果解释中提取并迁移因果像素证据，以确定性、可控制的方式生成能够翻转分类器预测的最小反事实图像，从而提供对分类器决策边界的直接、透明审计。

papers.title: SpatialGuard: Harness-Guided Verifiable Spatial Reasoning for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Ziyun Qian, Zizhi Chen, Yizhou Liu, Mingyang Sun, Dingkang Yang, Lihua Zhang
papers.affiliations: College of Intelligent Robotics and Advanced Manufacturing, Fudan University; Fysics Intelligence Technologies Co., Ltd. (Fysics AI)
papers.intro: SpatialGuard提出了一种基于布局引导的可验证空间推理框架，通过引入"布局约束带"（Layout Harness）机制，将复杂3D空间文本到图像生成从隐式提示跟随转变为可验证的规划-实现-验证-修复闭环过程。

papers.title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
papers.authors: Danze Chen, Zeqing Wang, Ziyue Lin, Xingyi Yang, Yeying Jin
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Tencent, National University of Singapore, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: H3-World提出了一种高效框架，通过将角色和相机动作表示为组合式文本指令，并引入时间注意力路由机制，仅用0.199%的可训练参数将33B参数的MiniMax-H3视频生成器转化为精确、时间可控的交互式世界模型。

papers.title: Revisiting Cross-View Completion: Self-Supervised Pre-Training via Reconstruction Error Comparison
papers.authors: Thibaut Loiseau, Guillaume Bourmaud, Vincent Lepetit
papers.affiliations: LIGM, Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, IP Paris, Univ Gustave Eiffel, CNRS, France; Univ. Bordeaux, CNRS, Bordeaux INP, IMS, UMR 5218, France
papers.intro: 本文提出Gekko，一种通过预测跨视角补全误差与掩码自编码误差之间的相对改进量来提供全掩码区域双目训练信号的自监督预训练方法，在零样本对应估计、相对位姿估计和点图回归等任务上一致优于CroCo。

papers.title: DualDiff3D: Dual Structure-Appearance Diffusion Priors for Reliability-Enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Qian Wang, Yu Wang, Weiqi Li, Xinhua Cheng, Xiandong Meng, Ronggang Wang, Jian Zhang
papers.affiliations: School of Electronic and Computer Engineering, Peking University, Shenzhen, China; Pengcheng Laboratory, Shenzhen, China; Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Ultra High Definition Immersive Media Technology, Shenzhen, China
papers.intro: 本文提出DualDiff3D，通过双分支扩散先验（结构分支与外观分支）配合结构-外观注意力（SAA）模块解耦处理结构和外观信息，并集成可靠性增强的渲染-精化-优化（RRO）循环，实现对稀疏视角下3DGS重建质量的显著提升。

papers.title: TempCloze: Can Video-LLMs Identify the Missing Middle?
papers.authors: Wenqi Pei, Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Yilai Liu, Jiahao Meng, Han Chen, Ziyu Wang, Hongyang Du
papers.tags: video segmentation, video generation, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Peking University
papers.intro: TempCloze是一个视频完形填空基准，通过让模型从四个候选中识别给定开头和结尾之间的真实缺失中间段，从语义、对齐和进展三个维度评估Video-LLMs的视觉时间推理能力，并揭示了对齐（Alignment）是当前模型的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: CameraEditor: Camera-Controlled Image Editing via Video-Prior Sequential Modeling
papers.authors: Xin Shen, Chengyou Jia, Keshuo Xing, Zifeng Zhu, Changliang Xia, Bowen Ping, Zhuohang Dang, Hangwei Qian, Minnan Luo
papers.tags: image generation, video generation, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: 西安交通大学（Xi'an Jiaotong University）、新加坡科技研究局（A*STAR）
papers.intro: CameraEditor提出了一种将相机控制图像编辑从空间问题重构为时间序列预测任务的框架，通过利用视频扩散模型的时间一致性、显式几何感知模块和动态参考路由机制，实现了精确的相机参数化编辑，并配套构建了训练数据集和评估基准CamEditor-Bench。

papers.title: Gaussian Core LoRA: Distribution-Aware Dynamic Adaptation for Broad Concept Erasure
papers.authors: Qinghui Gong, Xunlei Chen, Yu-Xuan Zhang, Hua Meng, Zhengchun Zhou
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University（Qinghui Gong, Yu-Xuan Zhang, Hua Meng, Zhengchun Zhou）；University of Electronic Science and Technology of China（Xunlei Chen）
papers.intro: 本文提出Gaussian Core LoRA，一种分布感知的动态低秩适配框架，通过在高斯混合模型中建模目标概念的潜在语义原型，并根据输入提示的分布位置动态重构共享LoRA秩空间，实现对广泛概念的原型自适应擦除。

papers.title: Pix2Rep-v2: Data-Efficient Representation Learning for Dense Medical Imaging Applications
papers.authors: S. Sifaoui, E. Angelini, S. Toupin, T. Pezel, L. Le Folgoc
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: LTCI, Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, Palaiseau, France; MIRACL.ai Laboratory, Hôpital Universitaire Lariboisière (AP-HP), Paris, France; Université Paris Cité, Inserm MASCOT, Paris, France
papers.intro: Pix2Rep-v2提出了一种基于冗余消除目标和等变性原则的密集自监督学习框架，通过高效的像素级表示学习和多尺度补丁采样策略，在少样本医学影像分割任务中显著超越全监督基线，并支持无需微调的原位上下文分割和视频传播。

papers.title: Semantic-Guided Multimodal Preprocessing for Vision Transformer-Based Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Grading
papers.authors: Fatemeh Javadian, Zhu Chen, Zahra Aminparast, Johannes Stegmaier
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, vision transformer, semantic segmentation
papers.affiliations: RWTH Aachen University, Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf, Kermanshah University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种语义引导的多模态预处理方法，通过将预训练细胞核分类模型的分类图与RGB组织病理图像融合，使Vision Transformer能够同时利用细粒度细胞核分级信息和粗粒度组织上下文进行CCRCC分级，在保持RGB纹理特征的同时显著提升分级性能。

papers.title: EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories
papers.authors: Christian Greisinger, Zhixue Zhao, Steffen Eger
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: University of Technology Nuremberg（Christian Greisinger, Steffen Eger）；University of Sheffield（Zhixue Zhao）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种从自然发生的科学修订轨迹中挖掘大规模编辑监督数据的方法，构建了首个大规模科学图表编辑数据集DaEdiTikZ（391K编辑对），并训练了紧凑的EdiTikZ模型（4B和9B），在自动和人工评估中超越GPT-5.6-Sol并与Gemini-3.1-Pro持平。

papers.title: BRF-GS: Hyperspectral Bidirectional Reflectance Factor Modeling and Image Generation Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Yiling Yao, Wenjuan Zhang, Bowen Wang, Bocheng Li, Wentao Song, Bing Zhang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences; International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出BRF-GS，一种基于3D高斯泼溅的框架，通过引入混合BRDF驱动核表示、几何可靠波段选择和几何-光谱解耦的两阶段训练策略，实现遥感场景中高光谱双向反射因子建模和多角度反射率图像的高效生成。

papers.title: VeriCam: A Verification Baseline for the Classification of Unknown Data
papers.authors: Lucas Wojcik, Gabriel E. Lima, Sergio M. Silva, Eduil Nascimento, David Menotti
papers.tags: image classification, vision transformer, image retrieval, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Federal University of Paraná（巴拉那联邦大学）；Paraná Military Police（巴拉那州军事警察）
papers.intro: VeriCam提出了一种基于验证网络（verification network）的零样本分类流水线，通过训练模型判别图像对是否属于同一类别来构建关系图，再利用图聚类算法实现对未知类别的动态识别，并在LPLCv2交通监控数据集上验证了其有效性。

papers.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
papers.authors: Jiashu Zhu, Yanhao Zheng, Ruitian Tian, Rujing Dang, Shen Zhang, Bingze Song, Jiachen Lei, Ruimin Lin, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: DreamX Team, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: DreamX-Creator 1.0 是一个以7B参数生成器为核心的紧凑型原生联合音视频生成系统，通过门控跨模态注意力、渐进式联合训练、音视频强化学习和自回归1步2K细化流水线，实现了与最先进开源系统竞争性能的原生同步音视频生成，并开源了模型权重。

papers.title: Real-Time Video Anomaly Detection Using YOLO Pose Estimation and CLIP-Based Semantic Scoring
papers.authors: Vanodhya G. Warnasooriya, Amir Hajian, Watchara Ruangsang, Supavadee Aramvith
papers.tags: pose estimation, CLIP, YOLO, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Chulalongkorn University, King Mongkut's Univ. of Technology Thonburi
papers.intro: 本文提出一个轻量级两阶段视频异常检测框架，利用YOLO v11n-pose进行人员检测与姿态估计，再通过CLIP ViT-B/32对裁剪的人员区域进行文本-图像语义相似度评分，以直接余弦相似度替代多特征密度估计，在保持可比精度的同时实现3.36倍吞吐量提升（51.39 FPS）。

papers.title: Identity-Conditioned Latent Consistency Distillation for Face Synthesis
papers.authors: Tiago Kienen Chaves, Bernardo Biesseck, David Menotti
papers.affiliations: Federal University of Paraná（UFPR）；Bernardo Biesseck 同时隶属于 Federal Institute of Mato Grosso (IFMT)
papers.intro: 本文通过将Arc2Face扩散模型（教师）蒸馏为潜在一致性模型（学生），在保持图像质量的前提下，将身份条件化人脸生成的推理速度提升4.36倍，实现了大规模合成人脸数据集的高效生成。

papers.title: Segmentation of Bovid Dentition Under Imperfect Annotations: A Comparative Study of Convolutional and Attention Models
papers.authors: Keith G. Mills, Evan B. Sanders, Gregory J. Matthews, Juliet K. Brophy
papers.affiliations: LSU ATHENA Lab, Loyola Dept. Math & Stats, LSU Dept. Geography & Anthropology
papers.intro: 本文系统比较了从卷积神经网络到视觉Transformer的多种语义分割架构在标注不完美的B.O.V.I.D.牛科牙齿数据集上的表现，发现预处理技术对定量指标影响有限但对定性结果影响显著，且轻量级CNN编码器（如MobileNetV2）在性能上可与计算量数倍于其的SegFormer相媲美。

papers.title: DARP: A Calibrated Dual-Arm RGB-D-IR Dataset for Multi-View Robotic Perception
papers.authors: Manish Kansana, Mohammed Yusuf Mujawar, Sudip Mittal, Shahram Rahimi, Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, depth estimation, point cloud, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, The University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出了DARP，一个由两台独立移动的眼在手机械臂采集的校准双RGB-D-IR数据集，通过保留传感器原始记录、机器人关节状态和校准信息，实现了共享度量坐标系下的多视角物体感知与确定性几何融合评估。

papers.title: Multi-View Reflective Surface Inspection via Semantic-Saliency Cross-Verification
papers.authors: Van-Giang Nguyen, Thanh-Tuan Tran, Xuan-Hieu Phan, Xiem HoangVan
papers.tags: object detection, image generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: University of Engineering and Technology, Vietnam National University, Hanoi 10000, Vietnam
papers.intro: 本文提出一种多视角反光表面检测框架，通过视觉语言模型产生的语义框与正常参考重建分支产生的显著性图进行空间交叉验证，在不修改语义坐标的前提下对检测结果进行重排序，并在产品层面无需跨视角配准地聚合多视角证据。

papers.title: Vision Models Predict Urban Scene Appraisal with Limited Neural Alignment
papers.authors: Kaizhen Tan, Yuantao Deng
papers.affiliations: New York University
papers.intro: 该论文通过EEG数据系统评估了十七种视觉表征与人类城市场景神经几何的对应关系，发现当前视觉模型虽然能很好地预测人类评价（r=0.87），但与神经表征的对应度普遍较低（最高仅达噪声下限的29.6%），且预测能力与神经对齐度不相关。

papers.title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
papers.authors: Walid Bousselham, Mathilde Caron, Arsha Nagrani, Cordelia Schmid
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Google DeepMind
papers.intro: LOCI提出了一种无需训练的Locator-Critic多智能体框架，通过将视觉证据搜索与证据验证解耦，并利用迭代精化循环，显著提升了VLM在复杂视觉问答基准上的性能。

papers.title: Failure or Drift? Evaluating Monocular SLAM under Synthetic and Real-World Corruptions
papers.authors: Abhay Skaria Thomas, Shashank Agnihotri, Margret Keuper
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, autonomous driving, scene understanding, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: University of Mannheim, Germany; Max-Planck-Institute for Informatics, Saarland Informatics Campus, Germany
papers.intro: 本文通过对比ORB-SLAM2、DPVO和DROID-SLAM在图像空间、几何感知和复合退化以及4Seasons真实恶劣条件下的表现，揭示了合成退化的物理保真度会改变学习型跟踪器的相对排序，并提出了区分显式跟踪失败与隐式漂移的失败感知评估协议。

papers.title: CANVAS: Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling for Long-Context Text-to-SVG Generation
papers.authors: Yichen Wu, Haoxuan Qu, Yihang Lou, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu
papers.affiliations: University of Nottingham, Lancaster University, Peking University
papers.intro: CANVAS是一个无需训练、渲染感知的推理框架，通过将功率锐化的轨迹似然与渲染未来的视觉反馈相结合，推导出笔画级导航规则，在有限生成和渲染预算下自适应分配采样资源，从而提升长上下文Text-to-SVG生成的全局一致性。

papers.title: Quanta Perception as Probabilistic Events
papers.authors: Varun Sundar, Pavan Thodima, Sacha Jungerman, Mohit Gupta
papers.tags: pose estimation, object detection, image generation
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Sciences, University of Wisconsin–Madison, Wisconsin, United States
papers.intro: 本文提出"概率事件"（probabilistic events）这一计算原语，通过递归贝叶斯推断直接在光子流上进行实时量子感知，将光子流表示为关于强度变化时间的后验信念状态，从而在无需重建强度帧的情况下实现低延迟、高吞吐的极端环境感知。

papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.authors: Liyan Tang, Cyrus Rashtchian, Chun-Sung Ferng, Andrew Tomkins, Da-Cheng Juan, Tu Vu

papers.title: Retrieval Heads Meet Vision: Uncovering How VLMs Locate and Extract Visual Information
papers.authors: Chanho Park, Daehyeon Choi, Jihyun Lee, Minhyuk Sung

papers.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators

papers.title: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
papers.authors: Lukas Kuhn, Lucas Maes, Giuseppe Serra, Quentin Le Lidec, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero, Florian Buettner

papers.title: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models

papers.affiliations: 121-labs.com, Remscheid, Germany

papers.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
papers.authors: Yuandong Pu, Le Zhuo, Sayak Paul, Gabriel Jorge Menezes, Avram Đorđević, Shiyang Li, Yifan Zhou, Bin Fu, Wenlong Zhang, Junjun He, Yu Qiao, Yihao Liu, Jingbo Xing, Xi Chen

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of 3D Reconstruction Methods for Immersive Visualization of Laboratory Objects
papers.authors: Brian De La Cruz, Aaron Y. Zhao, Maitrey Gramopadhye, Sawyer J. Lazar, Xianming Tan, Daniel Szafir, David S. Lawrence

papers.title: Detection of Christmas tree plantations from high-resolution aerial imagery. A case study in the French Morvan
papers.authors: Francesca Razzano, Emanuele Dalsasso, Adrien Baysse-Lainé, Silvia Liberata Ullo, Gilda Schirinzi, Jocelyn Chanussot

papers.title: TADP: Task-Aware Deformable Prediction for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection
papers.authors: Su Wang, Yaochen Li, Min Yang, Jiaohao Nie, Chang Liu, Yuehu Liu

papers.title: Sidecar: Training-Free Semantic Reuse for Character-Consistent Free-form Visual Storytelling

papers.title: DINOcular: Self-Supervised Visuospatial Representations
papers.authors: Farkhat Almukhamedov, Sami Azirar, Hermann Blum

papers.title: CODE: Cross-Modal Calibration and Dynamic Suppression for Open World Object Detection

papers.title: PACE: A Unified Condense-and-Extract Paradigm for Fast VLM Inference
papers.authors: Junjie Liu, Shengyuan Ye, Xu Chen

papers.title: Vision-centric generative AI models: A software-hardware perspective
papers.authors: Eleni Tselepi, Cristian Sestito, Shady Agwa, Themis Prodromakis

papers.title: SSMB: Self-Supervised Local Feature Detection under Motion Blur

papers.title: Ancient-Bench: A Comprehensive Multi-millennial, Multi-medium, and Multi-script Benchmark for Ancient Chinese Artifact Text Recognition

papers.title: ReViCo: Unveiling the Limitations of VLMs in Visual Text Understanding via Error Correction

papers.title: How AI Experiences Art: Emergent Aesthetic Structure in a Self-Supervised Multimodal Embedding Space

papers.title: Automated 2D and 3D Segmentation of AMD and DME Lesions in OCT

papers.title: TAU-Agent: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Traffic Anomaly Understanding

papers.title: Diffuse the object, keep its label: curating detector training data from a few unlabeled photographs via VLM-built 3D vegetation scenes
papers.authors: Mario Malizia, Marnix Enting, Rob Haelterman, Ken Hasselmann
papers.tags: object detection, diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: Royal Military Academy, Brussels, Belgium; KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium; Flanders Make, Heverlee, Belgium

papers.title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Jiahao Shao, Yuanbo Yang, Yiyi Liao, Yujun Shen, Ceyuan Yang, Yinghao Xu

papers.title: You Only Flow Once: Calibrated and Real-Time Radar Pose Estimation with Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flows
papers.authors: Jonas Leo Mueller, Sebastian Hoefler, Dario Zanca, Naga Venkata Sai Jitin Jami, Thomas Altstidl, Bjoern M. Eskofier
papers.affiliations: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg; Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML); LMU München; Helmholtz Zentrum München
papers.intro: 本文提出MH-NFPG，利用条件归一化流将雷达点云映射为校准的多假设3D姿态分布，通过单次前向传播实现实时推理，并在精度和校准上超越扩散模型。

papers.title: A Height-Constrained 2-Point Minimal Solver for Pose Estimation from Active LED Markers with Event Cameras
papers.authors: Runze Yuan, Alexander Kappler, Jun Zhang, Kuangyi Chen, Fabio Morbidi, Pascal Vasseur, Cédric Demonceaux, Friedrich Fraundorfer
papers.affiliations: Graz University of Technology（Institute of Visual Computing）；University of Picardie Jules Verne（MIS laboratory）；University of Burgundy Europe（ICB laboratory）
papers.intro: 本文推导了一种仅利用两个LED标记点、结合已知倾斜角和相机高度的最小位姿求解器（高度约束P2P），通过闭式解和线性最小二乘两种方式唯一确定相机位姿，并在合成和真实数据上验证了其相对于现有P2P/P3P方法的优越性。

papers.title: CableDex: Cable Length Estimation on Industrial Reels Using a Handheld Device
papers.authors: Francisco Guillén, Ricardo Almeida, Bruno Silva, João C. Neves
papers.affiliations: Francisco Guillén - University of Beira Interior, NOVA-LINCS UBI, Portugal Bruno M. C. Silva - University of Beira Interior, IT - Instituto de Telecomunicações, Portugal João Neves - University of Beira Interior, NOVA-LINCS UBI, Portugal

papers.title: LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search
papers.authors: Yulun Zhang, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Wenbo Wang, Zihang Qiu, Zhilin Wang, Ruxin Wang, Yupeng Hu

papers.title: Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Tianchen Deng, Chongdi Wang, Nailin Wang, Lei Zhao, Ziqi Ma, Tianjun Zhang, Zhe Liu, Danwei Wang, Hesheng Wang

papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学（School of Automation and Intelligent Sensing, Shanghai Jiao Tong University）、卡内基梅隆大学（Carnegie Mellon University）、南洋理工大学（Nanyang Technological University）

papers.title: Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Ziheng Jia, Yingji Liang, Jiaying Qian, Xiongkuo Min
papers.affiliations: 1Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 2East China Normal University

papers.title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence
papers.authors: Joshua Castillo, Santosh Nukavarapu, Ravi Mukkamala
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Old Dominion University

papers.title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis
papers.authors: Kalelo Dukuray, Israel Pina, Evan Perez, Erika Ardiles-Cruz, Jie Wei
papers.affiliations: City College of New York（Dept. of Computer Science）；Air Force Research Lab（Rome, NY）

papers.title: A Dynamic-Semantics Framework for Grounding Human Referring Expressions in Visual Perceptual Data

papers.title: Your VLM Already Knows When: Training-Free Temporal Grounding by Asking Yes or No

papers.title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence
papers.authors: Sankalp Nagaonkar, Rohit Garg, Ankit Raj, Ashish Choithani, Ashutosh Trivedi
papers.affiliations: VideoDB

papers.title: Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence
papers.authors: Jieyu Zhang, Ziqi Gao, Luke Zettlemoyer, Ranjay Krishna

papers.title: Keep It Simple: Multi-Key Episodic Memory Retrieval for Ultra-Long Video Understanding

papers.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress

papers.title: Conformal Coverage Guarantees for Any Video Temporal Grounder

papers.title: I Seek You in Videos: Identity-Conditioned Queries for Person-Centric Video Reasoning

papers.title: UniJEPA: A Unified Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Task-Agnostic Visual World Modeling

papers.title: LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering
papers.authors: Xuye Liu, Yimu Wang, Peng Shi, Bo Xue, Xiangrui Ke, Songcheng Cai, Kath Choi, Di Wu, Freda Shi, Krzysztof Czarnecki

papers.title: H2AL: Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning for Registration-based Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation

papers.title: Same Attention, Different Truths: Put Logit-Lens over Visual Attention to Detect and Mitigate LVLM Object Hallucination

papers.title: Gaze Behavior in Visual World Experiments Can be Modeled With Off-the-shelf Language-Vision Encoders

papers.title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN

papers.title: InstanceSplat: Instance-Aware Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scene Understanding

papers.title: Human-AI Perceptual Alignment by Playing Hues and Cues

papers.title: Beyond Fluency: A Clinical Benchmark and Anomaly-Enhanced Baseline for Spine MRI Report Generation
papers.authors: Bruno Palau, Franziska Vogt, Daria Laslo, Haobo Li, Ender Konukoglu, Maria Monzon, Catherine R. Jutzeler

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Camera Localization for Bronchoscopy

papers.title: Debias in Text, Believe Your Eyes: Text-Anchored Cross-Modal Transfer for Visual Counter-Commonsense Reasoning

papers.title: Rhetorical-Role-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Legal Question Answering over Indian Supreme Court Judgments

papers.title: CoDAT: Collaborative Dual-Attention Transformer with Low-Cost Temporal Modeling for Efficient Edge Action Recognition

papers.title: UQ-Loc: Uncertainty-Aware LiDAR Scene Coordinate Regression

papers.title: NeSy-RAG: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Explainable Question Answering

papers.title: OTLesMix: Wasserstein Barycenter and Optimal Transport Map for Synthetic Lesion Generation with Diverse Shapes and Locations

papers.title: MultiCompose: Multi-Concept Personalized Composition with Per-Subject Attribute Binding

papers.title: Keep the Needle, Prune the Haystack: Defect-Preserving Token Pruning for Efficient Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection

papers.title: Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs
papers.authors: Woongkyu Lee, Jungwook Choi

papers.title: Finding Change in Satellite Archives from Text: How to Combine Before-and-After Images Efficiently
papers.authors: Simon Roy, Mark Bong, Giovanni Beltrame

papers.title: ScaFE: Data-Efficient Scar Classification with LLM-Generated Clinical Feature Programs
papers.authors: Ruman Wang, Hangting Ye
papers.affiliations: Liaoning University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; School of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University

papers.title: MarkushGlyph and OCSRGlyph: Improved Chemical Structure Recognition
papers.authors: Alex Andonian, Samuel G Rodriques, Andrew D White, Siddharth M Narayanan

papers.title: AuricularWorld: Hierarchical Action-Guided World Modeling for Fine-Grained Auricular Structure Segmentation from CT Scans
papers.authors: Jingwen Yang, Senmao Wang, Luoyao Kang, Runmeng Cui, Keying Zhang, Yunjia Bao, Haifan Gong, Lin Lin, Haiyue Jiang

papers.title: Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation
papers.authors: Antonio Delgado-Rosa, David Muñoz-Valero, Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin, Juan Moreno-Garcia

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Reason about AI Edits in Images?

papers.title: VisualRouter: Query-Grounded Visual Sampling for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Haiyue Zhang, Yi Bin, Xun Jiang, Zeyu Ma, Duo Peng, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen

papers.title: ViewMind3D: Modular View-Aware Inference for Training-Free 3D-QA

papers.title: Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees
papers.authors: Zihan Dong, Rui Qian, Qishi Zhan, Dongshen Peng, Kaixin Li, Yu Li

papers.title: Hand-Object Interaction in the Age of Large Foundation Models:Reconstruction, Generation, and Embodied Transfer

papers.title: How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents

papers.title: MonoVoc: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Lightweight Monocular Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussians

papers.title: Beyond Visual Ambiguity: Guiding Robust Monocular Depth Estimation in Challenging Scenarios via Detailed Long Captions

papers.title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
papers.authors: Hanzhang Zhou, Panrong Tong, Xu Zhang, Quyu Kong, Chenglin Cai, Tianyu Xia, Gongjie Zhang, Jianan Zhang, Long Li, Long Chen, Lei Wang, Gaole Dai, Pengxiang Li, Liangyu Chen, Yue Wang, Steven Hoi

papers.title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale

papers.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?

papers.title: SeasonStereo: Robust Dense Stereo Matching for Multi-Date Satellite Imagery via Generative AI

papers.title: Veritas++: Value-aware On-Policy Distillation for Perception-Enhanced AIGI Detection

papers.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better

papers.title: ARMOR++: Agentic Orchestration of a Multi-Domain Primitive Set for Transferable Attacks on Deepfake Detectors
papers.authors: Christos Korgialas, Gabriel Lee Jun Rong, Dion Jia Xu Ho, Pai Chet Ng, Xiaoxiao Miao, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis
papers.affiliations: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Singapore Institute of Technology, Columbia University, Duke Kunshan University, University of Toronto
papers.intro: ARMOR++是一种基于视觉-语言模型和大语言模型的多智能体框架，通过编排五种域互补的对抗原始操作（密集优化、显著性、空间变换、频域、块结构），在严格无查询黑盒迁移设置下高效地欺骗深度伪造检测器。

papers.title: CRISP: Constrained Refinement via Iterative Squeezing Process for Robust Medical Image Segmentation under Domain Shift
papers.authors: Yizhou Fang, Pujin Cheng, Yixiang Liu, Xiaoying Tang, Longxi Zhou
papers.affiliations: 南方科技大学（电子与电气工程系、生物医学工程系），香港大学，嘉兴研究院
papers.intro: CRISP提出一种模型无关的框架，基于“正区域排名稳定性”假设，通过潜在特征扰动提取高精度和高召回空间提示，并迭代挤压两者之间的不确定性间隙，实现无需目标域数据或测试时参数更新的鲁棒医学图像分割。

papers.title: Divergent Gaze Patterns in Artistic Viewing: Spatial and Temporal Signatures of Attention Across Autistic Individuals, Artists, and Neurotypical Observers
papers.authors: Mohammed Amine Kerkouri, Daphné Senggaran, Renaud Jusiak, Océane Lehmann, Marouane Tliba, Claire Wardak, Emmanuelle Houy-Durand, Shasha Morel-Kohlmeyer, Aladine Chetouani, Nadia Aguillon-Hernandez
papers.affiliations: F-initiatives (Paris, France); Université de Tours (Tours, France); Université d'Orléans (Orléans, France); Université Sorbonne Paris Nord (Villetaneuse, France)
papers.intro: 本研究通过双轴（空间+时间）定量框架对比自闭症成人、艺术家和神经典型观察者的自由观看眼动模式，发现艺术家和神经典型在空间和时间上高度一致，而自闭症个体具有独特的注意特征：空间探索类似艺术家（广散布），但时间上注视更短、更异质，且自闭症注视模式并非选择性更像任何一方。

papers.title: Structural-Semantic Reciprocal Learning for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Moyao Tian, Shijia Liu, Yan Yang, Xin Yuan, Minshi Chen, Wei Wang, Xiao Wang
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Technology, Wuhan University of Science and Technology；Hubei Province Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Processing and Real-Time Industrial System, Wuhan University of Science and Technology；State Key Laboratory of Robotics and Intelligent Systems, Shenyang Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences；China University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出结构-语义互惠学习框架（SSRL），通过细粒度结构解耦（FSD）提供跨模态空间锚点、闭环语义校准（CSC）过滤伪标签噪声，将传统开环渐进式关联转变为自校正的闭环系统，在无监督条件下实现鲁棒的可见光-红外行人重识别。

papers.title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
papers.authors: Maya Varma, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Sophie Ostmeier, Akshay Chaudhari, Curtis Langlotz
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, HOPPR
papers.intro: 本文提出了SYMBAL，一种两阶段结构化方法，利用现成基础模型自动检测MLLM生成描述中的系统性误对齐，并创建了首个专用基准SYMBALBENCH（包含170万图像-文本对、420个数据集），验证了方法的有效性。

papers.title: MAGiSt3R: Multi-Agent Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction from Monocular RGB Videos
papers.authors: Ziren Gong, Xiaohan Li, Fabio Tosi, Ninghui Xu, Stefano Mattoccia, Jianfei Cai, Matteo Poggi
papers.affiliations: 未明确（作者所属机构见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出MAGiSt3R，第一个多智能体前馈式3D重建框架，通过VGGT等3R模型生成局部点图，并利用新提出的MAGMA模块在智能体内和智能体间增量融合子图，配合位姿图优化，在单目RGB视频上实现接近10 FPS的高质量3D重建和相机跟踪。

papers.title: MM-IssueLoc: A Controlled Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Evidence in Multimodal Repository-Level Issue Localization
papers.authors: Shaoxiong Zhan, Shi Hu, Boyu Feng, Hai Lin, Andrew Gong, Zhengda Zhou, Jiaying Zhou, Yunyun Hou, Hao Su, Hai-Tao Zheng
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University; JD.com
papers.intro: MM-IssueLoc 是一个受控的多模态仓库级问题定位基准与评估协议，通过配对文本/图像模式、逐图像相关性和文件/函数级金标签，把视觉证据变成显式评估变量，揭示现有系统在多模态定位上的能力差距。

papers.title: DAPGNet: Dynamic Adaptive Physics-Guided Graph Diffusion Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.authors: Pengkun Wang, Weijia Cao, Ning Wang, Xiaofei Yang
papers.affiliations: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院, 中国科学院大学, 广州大学
papers.intro: DAPGNet通过多尺度光谱物理先验编码、物理先验感知的图构建和物理门控图扩散，将光谱物理先验注入图学习的全流程（拓扑、注意偏置、特征插值），在高光谱图像分类上显著超越CNN、Transformer、Mamba和图网络基线。

papers.title: AlphaWiSE: Adaptive Weight Interpolation for Continual Multimodal Representation Learning
papers.authors: Sarthak Jain, Qiran Hu, Zhen Zhu, Yaoyao Liu
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Google DeepMind
papers.intro: AlphaWiSE提出一种事后（post-hoc）权重空间插值方法，通过固定两个不同持续学习策略产生的冻结检查点，利用少量样本记忆学习每个参数张量的标量插值系数，融合生成单一模型，在不增加推理时间的前提下持续提升多模态检索性能。

papers.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
papers.authors: Xinhao Li, Yuhan Zhu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhao Dong, Haoning Wu, Zhiqiu Zhang, Yuandong Yang, Changlian Ma, Qingyu Zhang, Yansong Shi, Xinyu Chen, Haoran Chen, Zizheng Huang, Jun Zhang, Kun Ouyang, Lin Sui, Ziang Yan, Yicheng Xu, Chenting Wang, Yinan He, Hongjie Zhang, Yi Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Ziwei Liu, Kai Chen, Limin Wang
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, Peking University
papers.intro: VideoChat3是一个完全开源、高效且通用的视频多模态大语言模型，通过引入膨胀3D视觉Transformer（I3D-ViT）和自适应帧分辨率，实现高效时空编码，并配合大规模数据合成流水线，在4B参数量下超越同规模开源模型。

papers.title: Blurring Modal Boundaries: A Unified Survey from Single- to Multi-Modal Person Re-ldentification
papers.authors: Xiao Wang, Bing Wang, Bin Yang, Cuiqun Chen, Xin Xu, Mang Ye
papers.affiliations: 武汉科技大学；武汉大学；安徽大学
papers.intro: 本文系统性地综述了从单模态到多模态的行人重识别研究，提出了基于检索协议和学习目标的统一分类法，并给出了一个基于Transformer的可见光-红外ReID基线框架。

papers.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
papers.authors: Zhihao Xie, Junfeng Wu, Xinting Hu, Junchao Huang, Li Jiang
papers.affiliations: 香港中文大学（深圳）、华中科技大学、深圳环区域研究所、中国科学技术大学
papers.intro: VideoRAE利用冻结的视频基础模型编码器，通过轻量级1D自注意力投影器将多尺度层次特征压缩为紧凑的潜在空间，支持连续（扩散Transformer）和离散（自回归模型）两种生成范式，无需KL正则化，实现了高保真重建和更快的生成模型收敛。

papers.title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
papers.authors: Zhen Li, Zian Meng, Shuwei Shi, Mingliang Zhai, Jiaming Tan, Chuanhao Li, Kaipeng Zhang
papers.affiliations: Alaya Lab
papers.intro: 本文以传统游戏引擎的“动作-状态-观测”循环为组织框架，系统审视交互式游戏世界建模的四个维度，并构建了一个可扩展的数据引擎，为《黑神话：悟空》收集了90多小时带帧对齐动作、真实状态和语义标注的游戏数据。

papers.title: Multi-Expert Routing for Multi-Domain Low-Resource OCR: A Manchu Case Study
papers.authors: Zhan Chen, Jiqiao Ma, Chih-wen Kuo
papers.affiliations: Institute of Advanced Studies, Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai, China; Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, Beijing Normal University–Hong Kong Baptist University United International College (UIC), Zhuhai, China; Independent Scholar; Department of Applied History, National Chiayi University, Chiayi, Taiwan
papers.intro: 本文提出一个多专家路由系统，利用迭代微调过程中产生的检查点作为域专家，并训练一个轻量级页面级图像分类器来按视觉风格分配页面，在满文多域低资源OCR任务中达到与域标签oracle一致的最优精度（正楷0.30% CER，奏折1.57%，行书4.83%）。

papers.title: M$^\text{4}$World: A Multi-view Multimodal Driving World Model for Interactive Object Manipulation and Minute-long Streaming
papers.authors: Ke Cheng, Hanqiao Ye, Lei Shi, Yahui Liu, Yunhan Shen, Jingtao Dong, Zhenke Wang, Wenxuan Ao, Weixiang Xu, Kaining Huang, Shuhan Shen
papers.affiliations: Meituan, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 提出M4World，一种多视图多模态驾驶世界模型，通过结合细粒度物体控制接口（同时控制空间布局与视觉外观）和多阶段训练框架（实现四步去噪的因果流式生成），支持交互式物体操作和分钟级稳定滚动。

papers.title: Screening Is Effective for Visual Recognition
papers.authors: Shunya Shimomura, Kazuhiro Hotta
papers.affiliations: Meijo University
papers.intro: 论文提出 VisionScreen，将语言模型中的 Screening 机制扩展至二维图像网格，通过基于查询-键相似度的绝对相关性估计与阈值化显式排除低相关图像块，实现选择性特征聚合，在图像分类任务上超越标准 ViT。

papers.title: Peak-End-Net: A Peak-End Rule Inspired Framework for Generalizable Video Aesthetic Assessment
papers.authors: Geng Li, Haiwen Li, Rui Chen, Jing Tang, Lei Sun, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Group (AMAP) 和 Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.intro: 本文提出Peak-End-Net，一个受心理学“峰值-末端规则”启发的轻量级、可解释视频美学评估框架，通过图像美学先验、峰值-末端聚合、美学节奏编码和动态门控融合实现跨数据集的良好泛化。

papers.title: SIVA-RL: Sensitivity-Invariance Visual Alignment for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Cheng Tang, Junzhi Ning, Min Cen, Wei Li, Xinyi Zeng, Pinxian Zeng, Rongbin Li, Qiming Zhu, Yuqiang Li, Junjun He, Yirong Chen, Ming Hu
papers.affiliations: Cheng Tang - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Junzhi Ning - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Min Cen - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Wei Li - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University Xinyi Zeng - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence L

papers.title: Cyclone: Diffusion Model for Cycle-Consistent Weather Editing from Unpaired Driving Data
papers.authors: Thang-Anh-Quan Nguyen, Moussab Bennehar, Luis Guillermo Roldao Jimenez, Nathan Piasco, Dzmitry Tsishkou, Laurent Caraffa, Jean-Philippe Tarel, Roland Brémond
papers.affiliations: Noah's Ark, Huawei Paris Research Center, France; COSYS, Gustave Eiffel University, France; LASTIG, IGN-ENSG, Gustave Eiffel University, France
papers.intro: 本文提出Cyclone，一个基于潜在扩散模型和循环一致性约束的框架，利用图像-文本模型知识，无需配对数据即可实现从驾驶图像中生成和去除多种天气效果，并提升下游感知任务的鲁棒性。

papers.title: PiVoT: A Variational Solution for Real-time Large-scale Multi-object Detection and Tracking under Heavy Clutter
papers.authors: Runze Gan, Qing Li, Simon J. Godsill, Mike E. Davies, James R. Hopgood
papers.affiliations: University of Edinburgh; University of Cambridge
papers.intro: PiVoT是一种基于变分推理的快速、抗杂波、无需训练数据的多目标检测与跟踪框架，通过两阶段变分推理和多普勒感知测量模型，在严苛场景下显著超越现有贝叶斯跟踪器，性能与深度学习检测器相当。

papers.title: Towards Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning in Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Zhuoyuan Fu, Zeshang Li, Yiqiong Zhang, Hangui Lin, Yan Shu, Yan Li, Binyang Li, Yaru Zhao
papers.affiliations: University of International Relations, Beijing, China（朱悦源、李泽尚、张怡琼、林寒贵、李燕、李彬阳、赵亚茹）；University of Trento, Trento, Italy（舒燕）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于切片级数据合成范式的医学3D空间推理增强方法：通过双智能体框架（Observer-Synthesizer）从全局临床报告中生成精细的逐层链式思维（CoT）数据集，并利用该数据集指令微调2D预训练的MLLM，以低成本解锁其3D体积理解与可解释诊断能力。

papers.title: GHR-VLM: Making Zero-Shot Transit Video Analytics Realizable with Grounded Hybrid Reasoning
papers.authors: Kaicong Huang, Weiheng Oh, Jack M. Reilly, Thomas Guggisberg, Ruimin Ke
papers.tags: video segmentation, tracking, multimodal learning, edge deployment, video search
papers.affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute（Kaicong Huang, Weiheng Oh, Jack M. Reilly, Ruimin Ke）；Capital District Transportation Authority（Thomas Guggisberg）

papers.title: Personalizing Incremental Video Search with Hybrid Text and ID Embeddings
papers.authors: Vivek Kanojiya, Vishalaksh Aggarwal, Daeho Baek, Lyndon Kennedy, Xuetao Yin

papers.title: Eddy-VL 1.9B: Structural Pruning and Layered Distillation for Edge-Deployable Multimodal Embedding
papers.authors: HanYeong Cho, Changwoo Kim, Taeuk Chu, Jimin Park
papers.affiliations: Urock-AI Lab, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: 论文提出Eddy-VL 1.9B，一种基于Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B的压缩多模态embedding模型，通过探针驱动的结构化剪枝（28→24层文本解码器）和分层知识蒸馏，在减少约9.5%参数和约10%推理延迟的同时，保留教师模型91.7%的MMEB-V2性能，适用于离线边缘部署的多模…

papers.title: ScanFocus: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.authors: Kai Chen, Ming Dai, Wenxuan Cheng, Wankou Yang
papers.affiliations: Southeast University

papers.title: The Seriality Gap in Video Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Jorge Diaz Chao, Konpat Preechakul, Yuxi Liu, Yutong Bai
papers.affiliations: UC Berkeley
papers.intro: 论文通过可控硬球动力学实验，发现标准双向视频扩散模型在预测依赖事件链（串行复杂度）时存在“串行性差距”——性能随因果链增长而快速下降，而去噪步骤并不提供串行计算，相反，增加网络深度或采用自回归/分块生成等串行化推理能有效弥补这一差距。

papers.title: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
papers.authors: Yixiang Chen, Peiyan Li, Yuan Xu, Qisen Ma, Jiabing Yang, Kai Wang, Jianhua Yang, Dong An, He Guan, Gaoteng Liu, Jianlou Si, Jun Huang, Jing Liu, Nianfeng Liu, Yan Huang, Liang Wang

papers.intro: FlowWAM提出将光流作为统一的动作表示，通过双流扩散框架在共享的视频生成器中联合建模RGB和光流视频，既能以策略模式生成光流解码动作，又能以世界模型模式用给定光流引导未来视频生成。

papers.title: DermDepth: Toward Monocular Metric Scale 3D Reconstruction Models for Dermatology
papers.authors: Héctor Carrión, Narges Norouzi
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz, USA; University of California, Berkeley, USA

papers.title: X-Lens: Real-Time Metric Depth Estimation with Heterogeneous Cameras
papers.authors: Heng Zhou, Shuhong Liu, Yonghao He, Bohao Zhang, Fa Fu, Chenhui Hou, Xianbao Hou, Lijun Han, Wei Sui

papers.title: ViCo3D: Empowering LiDAR-based Collaborative 3D Object Detection with Vision Foundation Models

papers.title: Point Tracking in Surgery--The 2025 Surgical Tattoos in Infrared Challenge (STIRC2025)
papers.authors: Adam Schmidt, Mert Asim Karaoglu, Zijian Wu, Jiaming Zhang, Yuxin Chen, Tim Salcudean, Ho-Gun Ha, Minkang Jang, Kyungmin Jung, Ihsan Ullah, Hyunki Lee, Suresh Guttikonda, Sarah Latus, Alexander Schlaefer, Xinkai Zhao, Yuichiro Hayashi, Masahiro Oda, Takayuki Kitasaka, Kensaku Mori, Peng Liu, Chenyang Li, Stefanie Speidel, Aoife Gardiner, Agostino Stilli, Danail Stoyanov, Francisco Vasconcelos, Anwesa Choudhuri, Meng Zheng, Zhongpai Gao, Benjamin Planche, Van Nguyen Nguyen, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu, Alexander Ladikos, Omid Mohareri

papers.title: UniMedSeg: Unified In-Context Learning for Multi-Paradigm 2D/3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Yunzhou Li, Jiesi Hu, Yanwu Yang, Hanyang Peng, Chenfei Ye, Jianfeng Cao, Yixuan Yuan, Ting Ma

papers.title: Inhibited Self-Attention: Sharpening Focus in Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Peter R. D. van der Wal, Nicola Strisciuglio, George Azzopardi

papers.title: USS: Unified Spatial-Semantic Prompts for Embodied Visual Tracking with Latent Dynamics Learning

papers.title: $S^{2}$-FracMix: Label-Preserving Self-Saliency Mixup Augmentation

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Computer-Use Agents: A Benchmark across Vision-Language Models and GUI Grounding Datasets

papers.title: Dual Distribution Estimation for Zero-shot Noisy Test-Time Adaptation with VLMs

papers.title: Point Cloud Diffusion with Global and Local Reconstruction for Instance-Level 3D Anomaly Detection

papers.title: UniTeD: Unified Temporal Diffusion for Joint Perception and Planning in Autonomous Driving

papers.title: Efficient Real-World Dehazing via Physics-Inspired Global-Local Decoupling

papers.title: Falcon: Functional Assembly and Language for Compositional Reasoning in X-ray

papers.title: DiffusionBench: On Holistic Evaluation of Diffusion Transformers

papers.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
papers.authors: Dian Zheng, Harry Lee, Manyuan Zhang, Kaituo Feng, Zoey Guo, Ray Zhang, Hongsheng Li
papers.affiliations: CUHK MMLab（Dian Zheng, Kaituo Feng, Ray Zhang, Hongsheng Li）; Meituan（Dian Zheng, Harry Lee, Manyuan Zhang）; CUHK IMIXR（Zoey Guo）
papers.intro: InterleaveThinker是首个通过规划器-生成器-评论家多智能体管道赋予任意冻结图像生成器强交错生成能力的框架，利用专用数据集和单步强化学习（GRPO）实现长程生成轨迹的逐步校正，在交错生成和推理基准上均达到显著提升。

papers.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
papers.authors: Bardienus Pieter Duisterhof, Deva Ramanan, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Justin Johnson, Keunhong Park
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University; World Labs
papers.intro: Modality Forcing是一种简单、可扩展的后训练方案，通过为RGB和深度模态分配独立噪声水平，使单个DiT模型支持联合图像-深度生成、单向条件生成，且仅需稀疏深度数据训练，同时证明深度预测精度随T2I模型和数据规模提升而改善。

papers.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
papers.authors: Junke Wang, Qihang Zhang, Shuai Yang, Yiming Luo, Yujun Shen, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Yinghao Xu
papers.affiliations: Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University; Robbyant, Ant Group; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: RepWAM通过提出一种表示视觉-动作分词器，将视觉潜在变量与冻结的视觉基础模型对齐，并在同一语义空间中诱导出潜在动作令牌，从而构建一个表示导向的世界动作模型，显著提升了真实世界操作任务的成功率和仿真基准性能。

papers.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Seokju Cho, Ryo Hachiuma, Abhishek Badki, Hang Su, Byung-Kwan Lee, Chan Hee Song, Sifei Liu, Subhashree Radhakrishnan, Seungryong Kim, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Min-Hung Chen
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA（主要机构，作者Seokju Cho同时隶属于KAIST，标注为实习期间在NVIDIA工作）
papers.intro: 本文提出SpatialClaw，一个无需训练的空间推理框架，通过将代码作为动作接口（code as action interface），让VLM在持久化Python内核中逐步编写、执行和修正代码，灵活组合感知工具与数值计算库，显著提升开放式3D/4D空间推理能力。

papers.title: Flex4DHuman: Flexible Multi-view Video Diffusion for 4D Human Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jen-Hao Cheng, Yipeng Wang, Hao Zhang, Gengshan Yang, Jenq-Neng Hwang
papers.affiliations: University of Washington, World Labs
papers.intro: Flex4DHuman是一个基于扩散模型的多视角视频生成框架，它通过五轴位置编码（融合时空、视图索引和连续SE(3)相机几何）实现从单目或稀疏多视角视频到密集多视角视频的灵活生成，无需显式几何先验，并可直接用于下游4D高斯泼溅重建。

papers.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Mohamed El Banani, Jen-Hao Cheng, Paul Zhang, Yi Hua, Ben Mildenhall, Christoph Lassner, Narendra Ahuja, Gengshan Yang
papers.affiliations: World Labs, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
papers.intro: 本文提出World Tracing，一种生成式像素对齐多层几何表示，通过为每个输入像素预测一个有序3D点堆栈（第一层为可见表面，后续层为沿射线的遮挡表面），并基于流匹配扩散变压器WT-DiT进行高效建模，从而在单个框架内同时实现忠实的可见表面重建和完整的遮挡几何生成。

papers.title: Revisiting Vehicle Color Recognition in Long-Tailed Surveillance Scenarios
papers.authors: Vinícius Orrú, Bruno H. Foggiatto, Gabriel E. Lima, David Menotti, Rayson Laroca
papers.tags: image classification, image generation, video search
papers.affiliations: Pontifical Catholic University of Paraná (PUCPR), National High Court of Brazil, Federal University of Paraná (UFPR)
papers.intro: 本文针对长尾监控场景下的车辆颜色识别问题，使用两种现成生成模型（文本条件生成和图像条件颜色编辑）合成少数类图像，并系统融合现代视觉表示、损失重加权、颜色安全增强、前景预处理和集成融合等策略，在UFPR-VeSV数据集上将宏准确率提升至79.7%，较此前最佳结果提高8.2个百分点，并提供了详细的错误分…

papers.title: Edit the Bits, Diff the Codes: Bitwise Residual Editing for Visual Autoregressive Models
papers.authors: Shengqiang Zhang, Ruotong Liao, Volker Tresp, Barbara Plank, Hinrich Schütze
papers.affiliations: LMU Munich & Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)
papers.intro: 本文提出BitResEdit，一种无需训练的bitwise-residual VAR图像编辑器，通过BitEdit在采样前进行Bernoulli-KL信任域源负向引导，并通过ResEdit在采样后以掩码门控的连续代码残差实现定位编辑，在PIE-Bench上取得同类最强文本对齐性能。

papers.title: Measurement-Calibrated Multi-Camera Fusion for Vision-Based Indoor Localization
papers.authors: Mateo Toro Diz, Jonathan Hoss, Noah Klarmann
papers.affiliations: Rosenheim Technical University of Applied Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于测量校准的多相机融合方法，通过逐组件量化单相机局部化误差（单应性、人体检测、运动跟踪）并用于卡尔曼滤波器的测量噪声分配，实验表明与传统融合相比，该方法显著降低轨迹方差并改善运动平滑性，而对绝对精度提升有限。

papers.title: Heterogeneous LiDAR Early Fusion and Learned Re-Ranking Strategy for Robust Long-Term Place Recognition in Unstructured Environments
papers.authors: Judith Vilella-Cantos, Juan José Cabrera, Mónica Ballesta, David Valiente, Luis Payá
papers.affiliations: University Institute for Engineering Research, Miguel Hernández University
papers.intro: 本文提出MinkUNeXt-VINE++方法，通过早期融合两个不同LiDAR传感器（Livox Mid-360和Velodyne VLP-16）的点云数据并引入轻量级学习的重排序策略，在葡萄园等非结构化环境的地点识别任务中取得显著性能提升。

papers.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Cheng-Yu Yang, Shao-Yuan Lo, Yu-Lun Liu
papers.tags: scene understanding, visual grounding, image captioning, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (Cheng-Yu Yang, Yu-Lun Liu); National Taiwan University (Shao-Yuan Lo)
papers.intro: 提出Reroute，一种无需训练的即插即用方法，将视觉token的不可逆剪枝替换为可恢复路由：被推迟的token不永久删除，而是跳过当前阶段并保留在候选池中，在后续阶段可重新评分和入选，从而在不增加计算预算的前提下显著改善定位性能并维持通用VQA表现。

papers.title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
papers.authors: Jadelynn Dao, Milan Ganai, Yasmina Abukhadra, Ajay Sridhar, Mozhgan Nasr Azadani, Katie Luo, Clark Barrett, Jiajun Wu, Chelsea Finn, Marco Pavone
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, University of Waterloo, NVIDIA
papers.intro: 本文提出DIRECT框架，一个利用多模态场景上下文动态路由测试时计算资源的分配方法，通过为每个任务选择最合适的VLM规划器，显著提升了成功率与计算成本的帕累托前沿。

papers.title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jin Yao, Dhruva Dixith Kurra, Tom Lampo, Zezhou Cheng, Danhua Guo, Burhan Yaman
papers.tags: autonomous driving, multimodal learning, scene understanding, point cloud
papers.affiliations: Uber AV Labs; University of Virginia
papers.intro: VLGA首次在VLA模型中引入了一个受密集像素级点图重建损失监督的、参数隔离的几何专家，通过四专家混合变换器架构，同时实现了语言推理、密集空间接地和专用几何容量，在开放环路和闭环驾驶任务上均达到了最先进水平。

papers.title: Illumination-Robust Camera-Based Heart-Rate Estimation for Physiological Sensing in Robots
papers.authors: Zhi Wei Xu, Torbjörn E. M. Nordling
papers.tags: pose estimation, vision transformer, medical image
papers.affiliations: National Cheng Kung University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种端到端时空Transformer框架，集成PRNet 3D面部对齐、剪辑级光照增强、残差时间标准化模块和混合时频损失，在静态多光照协议下将心率MAE降至0.79 bpm，相比PhysFormer降低93.6%。

papers.title: A Turbo-Inference Strategy for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhen Zhao, Gang Zhang, Xiaolin Hu, Liang Tang
papers.tags: object detection, instance segmentation, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: School of Technology, Beijing Forestry University; Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University; Beijing National Research Center for Information Science and Technology, Tsinghua University; Chinese Institute for Brain Research (CIBR)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种无需重新训练模型的涡轮推理策略（Turbo-Inference Strategy），通过引入涡轮检测头（Turbo-Detection Head）和涡轮分割头（Turbo-Segmentation Head），在推理阶段迭代利用检测与分割之间的互补信息，同时提升目标检测和实例分割的精度。

papers.title: DepthMaster: Unified Monocular Depth Estimation for Perspective and Panoramic Images
papers.authors: Pengfei Wang, Shihao Wang, Liyi Chen, Zhiyuan Ma, Guowen Zhang, Lei Zhang
papers.tags: depth estimation, scene understanding, vision transformer, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: DepthMaster通过将全景图像分解为重叠的透视补丁、注入虚拟投影相机的几何先验，并引入对应一致性损失（CCL）作为软约束，在不修改标准Transformer架构的前提下统一了透视和全景的度量深度估计，在13个数据集上达到了最先进的零样本性能。

papers.title: Echoes of the Prior: A Computational Phenomenology of Forgetting
papers.authors: Gege Gao, Bernhard Schölkopf, Andreas Geiger
papers.affiliations: Gege Gao - Eberhard Karl University of Tübingen; Bernhard Schölkopf - Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems; Andreas Geiger - Eberhard Karl University of Tübingen, Tübingen AI Center
papers.intro: 本文提出一个名为“Echoes of the Prior”的交互式艺术安装，通过在3D高斯泼溅模型中引入受控的“突触衰减”，模拟记忆/感官流的结构性退化，从而可视化遗忘的主观现象学，并建立神经形态美学的框架。

papers.title: Natural-Language Temporal Grounding in Hour-Long Videos is a Search Problem: A Benchmark and Empirical Decomposition
papers.authors: Sukmin Seo, Geewook Kim
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, CLIP, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: NAVER Cloud AI；KAIST AI
papers.intro: 本文发布首个开放的小时级自然语言时间定位基准ExtremeWhenBench（2,273个查询/194个视频，平均75.7分钟），并通过实证分解证明小时级时间定位的瓶颈是搜索而非识别——所有开放Video-LLM在小时级视频上性能崩塌，而帧级检索基线反而超越它们，85%的失败归因于搜索失败，retr…

papers.title: Bridging the Modality Gap in Forensic Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Ricardo González-Gazapo, Annette Morales-González, Yoanna Martínez-Díaz, Heydi Méndez-Vázquez, Milton García-Borroto

papers.title: VOID: Defeating Unauthorized Mimicry in Latent Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Chunlin Qiu, Ang Li, Tianxiao Huang, Ruilin Gan, Yunjie Ge, Shenyi Zhang, Huayi Duan, Lingchen Zhao, Chao Shen, Qian Wang
papers.affiliations: 1 School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University; 2 School of Computer Science, Wuhan University; 3 Institute for Math&AI, Wuhan University; 4 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); 5 School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University
papers.intro: VOID提出了一种新的语义破坏范式，通过利用和操纵LDM的固有随机性（放大编码不确定性和抵消条件引导），实现了对未授权模仿的强大防御，同时保持了被保护图像的视觉质量。

papers.title: Bridging Day and Night: Unsupervised Cross-Domain Re-Identification with Synergistic Prompt and Prototype Learning
papers.authors: Jiyang Xu, Rui Liu, Hang Dai
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science, Wuhan University, Wuhan, China
papers.intro: 论文提出一种无监督跨域昼夜车辆重识别框架，通过协同实例感知提示学习和跨域原型匹配，在不使用人工标注的情况下实现了与全监督方法可比的Rank-1识别准确率。

papers.title: Q-Fold: Query-Aware Focus-Context Spatio-Temporal Folding for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Biao Tang, Xu Chen, Shuxiang Gou, Jingyi Yuan, Yuhan Zhang, Chenqiang Gao

papers.title: MFEN:Multi-Frequency Expert Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-ID
papers.authors: Xulin Li, Yan Lu, Bin Liu, Qinhong Yang, Qi Chu, Tao Gong, Nenghai Yu

papers.title: Plan-and-Verify Video Reward Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Scene Graph Grounding
papers.authors: Hyomin Kim, Junghye Kim, Joanie Hayoun Chung, Yoonjin Oh, Kyungjae Lee, Sungbin Lim, Sungwoong Kim

papers.title: Learning Instance-Adaptive Low-Rank Orthogonal Subspaces for Clothes-Changing Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Dong-Woo Kim, Tae-Kyun Kim

papers.title: SceneMiner: Identity-Preserving Multi-Task Fine-Tuning for Unified BEV Scene Mining
papers.authors: Abdalmalek Aburaddaha, Venkatraman Narayanan, Keval Thaker, Samir A. Rawashdeh
papers.affiliations: University of Michigan-Dearborn

papers.title: PT-WNO: Point Transformer with Wavelet Neural Operator for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Nhut Le, Maryam Rahnemoonfar

papers.title: 3D-CBM: A Framework for Concept-Based Interpretability in Generative 3D Modeling
papers.authors: Ahmad Al-Kabbany
papers.affiliations: Ahmad Al-Kabbany - Yubree Labs, Ottawa K2M1T2, Canada Ahmad Al-Kabbany - Multimedia Interaction and Communication Lab, Arab Academy for Science and Technology, Alexandria 21937, Egypt
papers.intro: 本文提出了3D-CBM框架，首次将概念瓶颈模型形式化地集成到3D生成管线中，通过多层级概念分类器实现点云/网格生成的可解释性与测试时人类干预。

papers.title: From Simulation to Real-World: An In-Field 6D Pose Dataset and Baseline for Robotic Strawberry Harvesting

papers.title: NSVQ: Mitigating Codebook Collapse by Stabilizing Encoder Drift in Vector Quantization

papers.title: DarkVGGT: Seeing Through Darkness Using Thermal Geometry without Daylight Tax

papers.intro: DarkVGGT提出一种物理启发的热-红外地几何融合框架，通过热分解和几何共享路由，在低光照下利用热红外信息提升3D估计精度，同时保留光线良好场景下的性能，避免了“日间税”。

papers.title: Semantic Segmentation of Node and Edge Diagrams for Assistive Technology
papers.authors: Michael Cormier, Yichun Zhao, Laura Paul, Cameron Swift, Duc Tri Dang, Miguel Nacenta
papers.affiliations: Mount Allison University（部分作者）、University of Victoria（部分作者）

papers.title: TRON: Tracing Rays to Orchestrate a Neural Renderer for 3D Gaussian Reconstructions

papers.title: ARM: An AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations
papers.authors: Junke Wang, Xiao Wang, Jiacheng Pan, Xuefeng Hu, Feng Li, Jingxiang Sun, Chaorui Deng, Zilong Chen, Yunpeng Chen, Kaibin Tian, Matthew Gwilliam, Hao Chen, Danhui Guan, Kun Xu, Weilin Huang, Zuxuan Wu, Haoqi Fan, Yu-Gang Jiang, Zhenheng Yang
papers.affiliations: Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University; ByteDance TikTok; ByteDance Seed
papers.intro: ARM是一种基于统一离散表示的纯自回归大模型，通过精心设计的离散语义视觉分词器、大规模自回归训练以及基于强化学习的偏好对齐，在图像理解、生成和编辑任务上取得领先或竞争力性能。

papers.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
papers.authors: Gangwei Xu, Qihang Zhang, Jiaming Zhou, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Xin Yang, Yinghao Xu
papers.affiliations: Robbyant, HUST, HKUST, HKUST (GZ)
papers.intro: 提出Next Forcing框架，通过轻量辅助多块预测模块（MCP）同时预测未来多个视频块，提供密集多尺度时间监督，实现更快训练收敛、更高精度和两倍推理加速。

papers.title: Workflow-GYM: Towards Long-Horizon Evaluation of Computer-use Agentic tasks in Real-World Professional Fields
papers.authors: Liya Zhu, Jingzhe Ding, Jian Zhang, Jianbo Xue, Shihao Liang, Ge Zhang, Yi Zhu, Duju Zeng, Xiang Gao, Qingshui Gu, Mailun Gao, Huimin Che, Yan Zhao, Peiheng Zhou, Haojun Wang, Chaobo Xian, Lili Le, Chi Wu, Yiwei Liu, Shengda Long, Jiale Yang, Fangzhi Xu, Sijin Wu, Haodong Duan, Chao He, Zhaojian Li, Minchao Wang, Huan Zhou, Jiani Hou, Chuqian Yu, Weiran Shi, Hongwan Gao, Jiamin Chen, Guanhong Chen, Tingqin Luo, Kaiyuan Zhang, Zhixin Yao, Qing Hua, Yuhao Jiang, Jin Chen, Pu Chen, Zhenyu Hu, Xingyu Li, Zhengxuan Jiang, Meng Cao, Tianfeng Long, Haozhe Wang, Mingzhang Wang, Yichen Zhang, Yiming Dai, Chenchen Zhang, Jiaying Wang, Xinying Liu, Xingzu Liu, Lingling Zhang, Xinjie Chen, Yujia Qin, Wangchunshu Zhou, Zhiyong Wu, Yang Liu, Jiaheng Liu, Lei Zhang, Shen Yan, Wenhao Huang, Zaiyuan Wang, Xiaolong Chang
papers.affiliations: ByteDance Seed, M-A-P, Humanlaya
papers.intro: 本文提出Workflow-GYM，一个面向专业领域、长时、经济上有价值的工作流的GUI代理评估基准，通过多领域专家构建的338个任务，揭示当前最强模型成功率仅略高于30%的显著差距。

papers.title: Density Ridge Selective Prediction for LLM and VLM Hallucination Detection under Calibration Label Scarcity
papers.authors: Nina I. Shamsi
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于密度脊（density ridge）的选择性预测方法来检测LLM/VLM幻觉，通过从生成过程中隐藏状态轨迹中提取六维运动特征，并在正确生成子集上拟合密度脊，以到脊的垂直距离作为置信度得分，在校准标签稀少（仅200个查询）的条件下取得了5-20个点的AUROC提升。

papers.title: Fisher-Guided Progressive Parameter Selection for Adaptive Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Ghodsiyeh Rostami, Po-Han Chen, Mahdi S. Hosseini
papers.affiliations: Concordia University, Mila - Québec AI Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出FisherAdapTune，一种基于Fisher信息结构漂移的自适应微调框架，通过Jensen-Shannon距离追踪参数组曲率的时间演化，渐进冻结趋于稳定的层，从而在降低泛化误差上界的同时保持任务适应能力。

papers.title: Making Time Editable in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Konstantin Kuklev, Viacheslav Vasilev, Alexander Kunitsyn, Andrei Ivaniuta, Denis Dimitrov
papers.affiliations: Kandinsky Lab
papers.intro: 提出一种基于显式时间分解（全局FPS控制+局部位潜在时间嵌入）的轻量级时间控制模块，扩展预训练DiT，使时间动态成为可直接编辑的变量，无需重新设计骨干网络。

papers.title: DB-3DME: From Dataset to Benchmark for Human-aligned Automatic 3D Mesh Evaluation
papers.authors: Nanshan Jia, Zhenyu Zhao, Sui Huang, Jingshen Wang, Zeyu Zheng
papers.affiliations: Nanshan Jia - University of California, Berkeley / Roblox Corporation（双标注优先以第一标注列UC Berkeley）；Zhenyu Zhao - Roblox Corporation；Sui Huang - Roblox Corporation；Jingshen Wang - University of California, Berkeley；Zeyu Zheng - University of California, Berkeley
papers.intro: 本文构建了一个包含2,619个合成3D mesh及其人工评分的数据集和基准（DB-3DME），系统评估了多个先进VLM，发现视觉编码是性能瓶颈，并通过对Qwen-2.5-VL-7B微调视觉编码器（冻结语言模型）实现了显著超越现有VLM的自动3D mesh评估能力。

papers.title: iSAGE: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation via Sparse Point Supervision
papers.authors: Osmar Luiz Ferreira de Carvalho, Osmar Abilio de Carvalho Junior, Anesmar Olino de Albuquerque, Daniel Guerreiro e Silva
papers.affiliations: University of Brasília
papers.intro: iSAGE通过让专家直接点击模型稳定错误（自信错误）的像素，使用错误加权Dice损失训练，在无需任何辅助扩展机制（伪标签、CRF等）的情况下，仅用0.011%的标注像素就在ISPRS Vaihingen数据集上匹配了全监督基线性能（76.78% mIoU vs 76.65%），成为31种调查方法中唯…

papers.title: Maximum Matching Accuracy: An Instance Segmentation Evaluation Metric Utilizing Globally Optimal Matching
papers.authors: Kaden Stillwagon, Alexandra D. VandeLoo, Craig R. Forest
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出Maximum Matching Accuracy（MMA），一种基于全局最优二分图匹配和像素级全局归一化的无阈值连续实例分割评价指标，克服了现有指标的不连续、低敏感度和匹配非最优问题。

papers.title: A Controlled Audit of Pretraining Contamination in Public Medical Vision-Language Benchmarks
papers.authors: Bruce Changlong Xu, Lan Wu, Alexander Ryu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, medical image, visual question answering, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Stanford University; University of California, Berkeley; Mayo Clinic
papers.intro: 通过对四个开源医学VLMs在三个医学VQA基准上的四探测器审计，发现SLAKE-En存在图像源重叠信号且Qwen2.5-VL在文本侧存在交换性信号，同时证明基于群体的Min-K%++和跨模型top-K重叠信号在小型医学群体中因校准混淆而不可靠，但图像近邻和交换性探测器仍有效。

papers.title: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
papers.authors: Ray Zhang, Marcus Greiff, Thomas Lew, John Subosits
papers.affiliations: Toyota Research Institute
papers.intro: 提出G-CVO，通过各向异性核嵌入局部表面几何信息，并结合二阶黎曼高斯牛顿优化，在无对应配准任务中实现比一阶方法快至10倍的收敛速度和更低的漂移。

papers.title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
papers.authors: Weijie Wang, Haoyu Zhao, Yifan Yang, Feng Chen, Zeyu Zhang, Yefei He, Zicheng Duan, Donny Y. Chen, Yuqing Yang, Bohan Zhuang
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学，微软研究院，阿德莱德大学，莫纳什大学
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于潜在空间的空间记忆（latent spatial memory）机制Mirage，将场景信息直接存储在扩散模型的潜在空间中，避免了像素空间的重建与编码，实现了更高效、信息无损的3D一致视频生成，并在世界生成基准上取得最先进性能。

papers.title: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
papers.authors: Wanli Li, Bowen Zhou, Yunyao Yu, Zhou Xu, Yifan Yang, Dongsheng Li, Caihua Shan
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学、微软亚洲研究院、清华大学
papers.intro: WeaveBench是一个长跨度、真实世界、混合接口的计算机使用代理基准测试，包含114个跨8个领域的任务，每个任务都要求代理在单一轨迹内协调GUI和CLI/代码操作，并通过轨迹感知评估器来防止作弊，实验表明最先进模型和运行时的最佳通过率仅为41.2%，远未饱和。

papers.title: Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Minghang Zheng, Zihao Yin, Yi Yang, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu
papers.tags: video segmentation, multimodal learning, video generation, diffusion model, video search
papers.affiliations: Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking University; Central Media Technology Institute, Huawei Technologies Ltd.; State Key Laboratory of General Artificial Intelligence, Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出TaRO（Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization）框架，通过构建性推理探索和时序敏感性奖励，显式增强MLLMs在视频时间定位中"随时间思考"的能力，实现最先进的性能。

papers.title: IMAGINE: Adaptive Schema-Imagery Enhanced Composition for Composed Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Jiale Huang, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Chunxiao Wang, Yupeng Hu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, vision transformer, video search
papers.affiliations: Shandong University; Qilu University of Technology (Shandong Academy of Sciences)
papers.intro: IMAGINE通过动态多模态原型显式物化“imagery space”（隐含语义空间），利用置信度调制的跨空间融合机制，在CVR和CIR任务中弥合显式视觉内容与隐式检索意图之间的鸿沟，并取得了SOTA性能。

papers.title: Decoupling Semantics and Logic: A Training-Free Coarse-to-Fine Pipeline for Video Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Jiaxin Dai, Zehang Wei, Jiamin Yan, Xiang Xiang
papers.affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology（华中科技大学），中国
papers.intro: 本文提出C2F-RAG，一个完全无需训练的两阶段级联视频RAG流水线，通过将语义检索（BGE-M3密集向量预取）与逻辑推理（基于LLM的适应型A.I.R.认知重排）显式解耦，实现了高精度检索、严格人设遵循和带chunk级时间引用的无幻觉生成。

papers.title: Watch, Remember, Reason: Human-View Video Understanding with MLLMs
papers.authors: Jiahao Meng, Yue Tan, Qi Xu, Kuan Gao, Weisong Liu, Yanwei Li, Jason Li, Lingdong Kong, Haochen Wang, Qianyu Zhou, Jiangning Zhang, Guangliang Cheng, Yunhai Tong, Lu Qi, Minghsuan Yang
papers.affiliations: Peking University; Wuhan University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Nanyang Technological University; CASIA; University of Tokyo; University of Liverpool; Zhejiang University; National University of Singapore; UC Merced
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于人类认知的“观看—记忆—推理”（Watch–Remember–Reason）统一视角，综述了MLLM视频理解领域的代表性方法、数据集、基准与未来方向。

papers.title: PAR3D: A Unified 3D-MLLM with Part-Aware Representation for Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Shaohui Dai, Yansong Qu, You Shen, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao
papers.tags: scene understanding, instance segmentation, multimodal learning, point cloud
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University
papers.intro: 本文提出了PAR3D，一个统一的零件感知3D-MLLM框架，通过引入带零件标注的合成数据集ScenePart、零件感知的3D表示学习和层级分割查询生成，使模型能够在3D场景中同时理解和定位物体及其精细零件。

papers.title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
papers.authors: Chenming Zhu, Jingli Lin, Yilin Long, Peizhou Cao, Tai Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Xihui Liu
papers.tags: image generation, scene understanding, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: 混合机构（详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出Astra框架，通过将VLM与一个动作条件型世界模拟器耦合，并利用强化学习训练VLM策略学会何时、何地、如何主动调用模拟器生成想象视图，从而提升视觉空间推理能力。

papers.title: A Vision-language Framework for Comparative Reasoning in Radiology
papers.authors: Tengfei Zhang, Ziheng Zhao, Lisong Dai, Xiaoman Zhang, Pengcheng Qiu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie
papers.tags: multimodal learning, medical image, image retrieval, visual question answering
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (Tengfei Zhang); School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Ziheng Zhao, Pengcheng Qiu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie); Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Tengfei Zhang, Ziheng Zhao, Pengcheng Qiu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie); Department of Radiology, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University (Lisong Dai); Shanghai Sixth People’s Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Lisong Dai); Department of Biomedical Informatics, Harvard Medical School (Xiaoman Zhang)
papers.intro: 该论文提出了一个实体感知的视觉-语言框架（MedReCo与MedReCo-VLM），通过构建大规模多模态数据集（MedReCo-DB），实现了可控制的参考病例检索和生成式时间对比解释，在内部、外部和跨中心评估中均显著优于基线方法。

papers.title: HomeWorld: A Unified Floorplan-to-Furnished Framework for Generating Controllable, Densely Interactive Whole-Home Scenes
papers.authors: Wenbo Li, Xiaoliang Ju, Zipeng Qin, Rongyao Fang, Hongsheng Li
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, scene understanding, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Ace Robotics, CUHK MMLab, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出一个统一的分层框架HomeWorld，通过结合大规模真实平面图数据集、LLM平面图生成、图像驱动的分层家具布局和VLM递归细化器，实现了从文本提示到可控、密集交互的完整家庭场景的自动化生成。

papers.title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Qiwei Zeng, Hao Wang, Jinghao Lin, Shuchang Ye, Yuezhe Yang, Yige Peng, Haoyuan Che, Jinman Kim, Lei Bi
papers.affiliations: Jilin University, The University of Sydney, ByteDance, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 本文提出EasyLens，一个无需训练、即插即用的微小病变表征放大器，通过在冻结的医学视觉语言模型的视觉嵌入空间中，利用原型推理和形态引导的残差增强，选择并强化病变相关补丁的表征，从而提升模型对微小病变的检测和报告生成能力。

papers.title: Towards One-to-Many Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Qi Xu, Yue Tan, Shihao Chen, Jiahao Meng, Anna Wang, Shunping Ji, Hao Fei, Jason Li
papers.affiliations: 武汉大学、北京大学、南洋理工大学、牛津大学（依据脚注：1Wuhan University, 2Peking University, 3Nanyang Technological University, 4University of Oxford）
papers.intro: 该论文首次系统性地定义并研究了“一对多时序定位（OMTG）”任务，通过构建包含56k样本的高质量数据集、设计自动化四阶段数据构建pipeline、提出新的评估指标（C-Acc和EtF1）以及基于时序奖励和字幕奖励的GRPO强化学习框架，使模型在OMTG Bench上取得43.65%的EtF1分数，大…

papers.title: RadiusFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling on CPUs and GPUs via Spherical Voxel Pruning
papers.authors: Ziyang Yu, Xiang Li, Qiong Chang, Jun Miyazaki
papers.affiliations: Institute of Science Tokyo (东京科学大学)
papers.intro: 本文提出RadiusFPS，一种基于球形体素剪枝的FPS加速框架，通过保守的几何边界剪枝和坐标级点跳过测试，在保持标准FPS更新规则和输出结果的前提下，在CPU和GPU上实现了显著的加速效果，并大幅降低了内存占用。

papers.title: GRAMformer: Any-Order Modality Interactions via Volumetric Multimodal Cross-Attention
papers.authors: Giordano Cicchetti, Eleonora Grassucci, Danilo Comminiello
papers.affiliations: Dept. of Information Engineering, Electronics, and Telecommunications, Sapienza University of Rome, Italy
papers.intro: 本文提出体积多模态交叉注意力（VMA），通过计算查询与多个键向量张成的平行多面体体积作为注意力分数，结合点积正则项，实现原生任意阶模态交互，并集成到轻量级Transformer架构GRAMformer中，在情感分析任务上取得更优性能。

papers.title: MemoVAD: Resource-Efficient Video Anomaly Detection via Dynamic Semantic Memory in Edge Computing Scenarios
papers.authors: Guo Li, Jiandian Zeng, Yang Li, Zihao Peng, Ke Chen, Tian Wang
papers.affiliations: 北京师范大学人工智能与未来网络研究院（珠海）；西南交通大学计算与人工智能学院；北京师范大学珠海校区大数据云边智能协同教育部工程研究中心
papers.intro: MemoVAD提出一种边缘-云协作的视频异常检测框架，通过不确定性感知门控和动态语义记忆，只对高不确定性和新颖的片段查询云端VLM，在显著降低通信开销的同时超越现有最先进性能。

papers.title: PerceptUI: LLM Agents as Human-Aligned Synthetic Users for UI/UX Evaluation
papers.authors: Nicolas Bougie, Xiaotong Ye, Gian Maria Marconi, Narimasa Watanabe
papers.affiliations: Woven by Toyota
papers.intro: PerceptUI是一个两阶段训练的框架，通过对比例子反思微调和基于失败轨迹的反思提示演化，实现人设条件化的UI/UX评价，在多项任务上达到人类水平的现实性和泛化能力。

papers.title: NextMotionQA: Benchmarking and Judging Human Motion Understanding with Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yong Cao, Chuqiao Li, Xianghui Xie, Gerard Pons-Moll, Andreas Geiger
papers.affiliations: University of Tübingen, Tübingen AI Center, Germany; Max Planck Institute for Informatics, Saarland Informatics Campus, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个3×3×3结构、包含1307个专家验证实例的人类运动理解基准NextMotionQA，对12个VLM进行多任务评测，并首次按难度分层分析了VLM作为T2M运动生成评测器的对齐可靠性。

papers.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Positional Bias in Multi-Video Summarization with MLLMs
papers.authors: Huangchen Xu, Yuan Wu, Yi Chang
papers.affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University; Engineering Research Center of Knowledge-Driven Human-Machine Intelligence, Jilin University; International Center of Future Science, Jilin University
papers.intro: 本文构建了一个多视频摘要位置偏差基准，提出Coverage、DPB、MEG三个互补指标，对9个开源和专有MLLM的评估表明位置效应具有模型和领域依赖性，并且仅靠定向偏差无法发现中间位置弱化问题。

papers.title: A Cookbook of 3D Vision: Data, Learning Paradigms, and Application
papers.authors: Hongyang Du, Zongxia Li, Dawei Liu, Runhao Li, Haoyuan Song, Qingyu Zhang, Yubo Wang, Jingcheng Ni, Shihang Gui, Congchao Dong, Tao Hu
papers.affiliations: Brown University, University of Maryland, College Park, University of Pennsylvania, University of Southern California, New York University, The University of Sydney, Stability AI
papers.intro: 本文提供了一份以数据为中心的3D视觉“食谱”，系统梳理了点云、网格、体素、3D高斯等几何表示、代表性数据集与基准、以及从2D监督3D学习到4D世界建模的学习范式，旨在为该领域构建一个统一的概念图谱。

papers.title: FindIt: A Format-Informed Visual Detection Benchmark for Generalist Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Eshika Khandelwal, Jingjing Pan, Mingfang Zhang, Quan Kong, Lorenzo Garattoni, Hilde Kuehne
papers.tags: object detection, multimodal learning, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Tuebingen AI Center, University of Tuebingen; Woven by Toyota, Inc., Tokyo, Japan; Toyota Motor Europe, Brussels, Belgium
papers.intro: 提出了首个针对通用多模态大语言模型可提示定位能力的全面基准（FindIt），通过标准化四个任务类别（物体检测、指代表达检测、实例级检测、视频检测）及多种边界框表示与输出格式，系统评估了开源和闭源MLLM的定位性能和格式遵循能力。

papers.title: A Dataset for Dynamic Human Preferences for Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Hannah Gao, Dylan Hadfield-Menell, Rachel Ma
papers.affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
papers.intro: 本文提出一个用于评估视觉语言模型对动态人类偏好（推理时传入的上下文偏好）理解能力的新基准，并设计了自动化生成管道，通过对开源和闭源模型的评测发现闭源模型显著优于开源模型，且所有模型在涉及边界框的图像上表现较差。

papers.title: StandardE2E: A Unified Framework for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Datasets
papers.authors: Stepan Konev
papers.tags: autonomous driving, BEV perception, LiDAR, scene understanding, multimodal learning
papers.intro: StandardE2E是一个统一的预处理和加载框架，通过定义规范的中间数据模式和可配置的适配器链，将多种端到端自动驾驶数据集映射到共享的npz缓存和Parquet索引，使得跨数据集训练和新增数据集仅需编写少量数据集特定代码即可完成。

papers.title: UniCanvas: A Diffusion-base Unified Model for Text-in-Image Joint Generation
papers.authors: Zeyuan Yang, Hao-Wei Chen, Xueyang Yu, Yuncong Yang, Haoyu Zhen, Ziqiao Ma, Maohao Shen, Chuang Gan
papers.affiliations: University of Massachusetts Amherst, University of Michigan, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
papers.intro: UniCanvas提出一种纯扩散模型，在共享像素画布上直接“绘制”文本和图像，通过流匹配和两阶段生成（推理→渲染）实现文本与图像的联合统一生成，无需外部VLM或离散令牌。

papers.title: Prospective Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstruction via Latent-Space Motion Tracking from Single Measurement
papers.authors: Lixuan Chen, Zhongnan Liu, Jesse Hamilton, James M. Balter, Jeong Joon Park, Liyue Shen
papers.affiliations: University of Michigan

papers.title: Demo2Tutorial: From Human Experience to Multimodal Software Tutorials

papers.title: CLI-Anything: Towards Agent-Native Computer Use

papers.title: Knowledge-Preserved Model Tuning in Null-Space for Robust Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.authors: Haoxuan Chen, Xianqin Liu, Jian-Fang Hu

papers.title: SCOPE: Real-Time Natural Language Camera Agent at the Edge

papers.title: BYORn: Bootstrap Your Own Responses to Defend Large Vision-Language Models Against Backdoor Attacks

papers.title: ATLAS: A Large-Scale Evaluation Benchmark for Adversarial LiDAR Perception

papers.title: GIRL-DETR: Gradient-Isolated Reinforcement Learning for Video Moment Retrieval
