papers.title: Colored Noise Diffusion Sampling
papers.authors: Hadar Davidson, Noam Issachar, Sagie Benaim
papers.affiliations: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem
papers.intro: 本文提出Colored Noise Sampling（CNS），一种无需训练、即插即用的随机求解器，通过时间步和频率依赖的彩色噪声注入，主动利用扩散模型的频谱偏置，将有限噪声能量优先分配到尚未被解析的频率频段，从而缩小生成分布与真实数据分布的频谱间隙，显著降低FID。

papers.title: Supercharging Thermal Gaussian Splatting with Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Manoj Biswanath, Chenxin Cai, Hannah Schieber, Daniel Roth, Benjamin Busam
papers.affiliations: 未明确（第一页作者列表未直接列出所属机构，但在正文第一页脚注中标注了各作者所属机构，详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出TDg（Thermal-to-Depth Gaussian Splatting）方法，通过集成从热红外图像估计的深度信息来监督3D高斯泼溅的几何优化，实现仅使用热红外单模态的高效新视角合成，显著缩短训练时间并提升渲染质量。

papers.title: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
papers.authors: Shihao Han, Hao Yang, Xinting Hu, Xiaofeng Mei, Yi Jiang, Xiaojuan Qi
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: ByteDance Inc., The University of Hong Kong, University of Science and Technology of China
papers.intro: Veda通过蒸馏全注意力的图块级结构，提出显式图块选择框架，结合统计感知评分和头部感知图块划分，在视频扩散模型中实现5.1倍端到端加速且不牺牲生成质量。

papers.title: City-Mesh3R: Simulation-Ready City-Scale 3D Mesh Reconstruction from Multi-View Images
papers.authors: Sayan Paul, Sourav Ghosh, Siddharth Katageri, Soumyadip Maity, Sanjana Sinha, Brojeshwar Bhowmick
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, point cloud, NeRF, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Visual Computing & Embodied AI Lab, TCS Research, India
papers.intro: 提出一个分布式端到端流水线City-Mesh3R，通过分治策略从无序图像直接重建水密、可仿真的城市级3D网格，包括拓扑图像聚类、分布式SfM、空间划分、几何感知相机选择、自适应密度网格优化与缝合。

papers.title: Not All Inputs Are Valid: Towards Open-Set Video Moment Retrieval Using Language
papers.authors: Xiang Fang, Wanlong Fang, Daizong Liu, Xiaoye Qu, Jianfeng Dong, Pan Zhou, Renfu Li, Zichuan Xu, Lixing Chen, Panpan Zheng, Yu Cheng
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Peking University, Zhejiang Gongshang University, Dalian University of Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Xinjiang University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文首次提出开放集视频时刻检索（OS-VMR）任务，并设计了一个名为OpenVMR的框架，利用归一化流技术学习ID查询分布、推理ID-OOD分离边界，并基于ID查询进行跨模态交互和时刻检索，实现对OOD查询的拒绝和ID查询的准确检索。

papers.title: Fewer Steps, Better Performance: Efficient Cross-Modal Clip Trimming for Video Moment Retrieval Using Language
papers.authors: Xiang Fang, Daizong Liu, Wanlong Fang, Pan Zhou, Zichuan Xu, Wenzheng Xu, Junyang Chen, Renfu Li
papers.tags: video search, video segmentation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学（Hubei Engineering Research Center on Big Data Security, School of Cyber Science and Engineering）、北京大学、河南大学、大连理工大学、四川大学、深圳大学
papers.intro: 本文提出SpotVMR，一种基于查询条件化的高效视频片段选择方法，通过轻量级BAM语义索引特征和递归片段选择机制，仅对少量查询相关片段进行昂贵的跨模态交互，在显著提升推理效率的同时保持甚至提升VMR检索性能。

papers.title: Learning User-Aware Recall: Personalized Retrieval in Long-Term Conversational Memory
papers.authors: ZhiShu Jiang, Haibo Liu, Xin Shen, Guanqiang QI, Chenxi Miao, Weikang Li, Liwei Qian, Xin Pei, Jizhou Huang
papers.affiliations: Baidu Inc.（百度）；The University of Queensland（昆士兰大学）
papers.intro: 本文提出PPRO（Profile-guided Personalized Retrieval Optimization）框架，通过用户画像引导的检索打分和基于GRPO训练的查询重写器，将长期对话记忆检索从"查询中心"升级为"用户感知且可优化"的检索流程，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S两个…

papers.title: Semantic and Visual Evidence for Efficient Long-Video Reasoning: A Solution for the HD-EPIC VQA Challenge
papers.authors: Yinsong Xu, Wei Jing, Liuxin Zhang, Wanjun Lv, Hui Li
papers.tags: video search, object detection, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Lenovo, China
papers.intro: 本文提出一个两阶段证据引导框架，通过离线构建可复用的语义证据（结构化文本）和视觉证据（对象级边界框与视觉嵌入），并在在线推理时进行查询条件化的证据检索与整合，从而高效解决长时程第一视角视频问答问题，在HD-EPIC VQA挑战中取得65.8%的整体准确率，显著超越所有基线方法。

papers.title: G3T Up! Gravity Aligned Coordinate Frames Simplify Pointmap Processing
papers.authors: Bharath Raj Nagoor Kani, Noah Snavely
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, point cloud, pose estimation, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: Cornell University
papers.intro: 本文提出重力接地几何变换器（G3T），通过将点图预测从相机中心框架迁移到重力对齐的直立框架，利用强结构先验减少旋转自由度，并进一步设计G3T-Long子图增量重建管道，显著提升3D重建精度和鲁棒性。

papers.title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
papers.authors: Shihao Wang, Shilong Liu, Yuanguo Kuang, Xinyu Wei, Yangzhou Liu, Zhiqi Li, Yunze Man, Guo Chen, Andrew Tao, Guilin Liu, Jan Kautz, Lei Zhang, Zhiding Yu
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, multimodal learning, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA (主要), The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Princeton University, Nanjing University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
papers.intro: 提出LocateAnything，通过并行框解码（Parallel Box Decoding, PBD）将每个边界框作为原子单元一步平行预测，在保持结构一致性的同时显著提升解码吞吐量和定位质量。

papers.title: Feedforward 3D Editing Learns from Semantic-Part Transformation
papers.authors: Jiawei Weng, Saining Zhang, Zhenxin Diao, Peishuo Li, Henghaofan Zhang, Junhao Chen, Hao Zhao
papers.tags: diffusion model, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: 本文提出通过语义部分变换来构建大规模高质量3D编辑配对数据集Pxform，并在此基础上设计了前馈编辑网络PartFlow，实现了无需推理时3D掩码的几何和外观通用3D编辑。

papers.title: When Eyes Betray AI: Social Gaze Consistency as a Semantic Cue for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.authors: Kim Jihyeon, Sohee Kim, Soosan Lee, Souhwan Jung, James Matthew Rehg, Hyesong Choi
papers.tags: image classification, image generation, diffusion model, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Kim Jihyeon - School of Computer Engineering, Hoseo University Sohee Kim - School of Electronic Engineering, Soongsil University Soosan Lee - School of Electronic Engineering, Soongsil University Souhwan Jung - School of Electronic Engineering, Soongsil University James Matthew Rehg - School of Comp
papers.intro: 本文提出社交注视一致性（两个人之间凝视方向、头-眼对齐、瞳孔放置的联合几何一致性）作为高层语义检测线索，通过配对编辑数据集（仅眼区局部修复）和块组合描述监督（固定推理骨架+表面多样性），在多个检测器上显著提升对生成图像的部分编辑伪造的检测精度，并揭示该线索与骨干网络无关、可跨生成器迁移。

papers.title: Towards Controllable Image Generation through Representation-Conditioned Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Nithesh Chandher Karthikeyan, Jonas Unger, Gabriel Eilertsen
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Linköping University, Norrköping, Sweden
papers.intro: 本文提出使用预训练自监督模型（DINO）的图像表示作为条件来训练潜在扩散模型（RCDM），通过在该表示空间中进行扰动、插值和语义方向发现，实现了无需标注数据的可控图像生成，并展示了表示空间的平滑性和一定解耦性。

papers.title: PARE: Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient Video Generation
papers.authors: Yutong Wang, Yunke Wang, Tianfan Xue, Yu Qiao, Yaohui Wang, Xinyuan Chen, Chang Xu
papers.affiliations: The University of Sydney, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: PARE通过结构感知的宽度剪枝（保护运动关键的时间注意力头）与内容自适应的块路由（根据去噪时间步和视觉内容动态选择要执行的块），联合压缩视频DiT的宽度和深度，在保持质量的同时大幅降低每步计算量，并能与步蒸馏进一步组合加速。

papers.title: EdgeFlow: Edge-Map Augmented VLM-Based Flowchart Processing for Industrial Requirements Engineering
papers.authors: Zhifei Dou, Shabnam Hassani, Ou Wei
papers.affiliations: Huawei Research Canada
papers.intro: EdgeFlow通过将确定性Canny边缘图作为结构先验与原始图像同时输入VLM，在不需训练数据或微调的条件下，显著提升工业流程图到Mermaid代码转换的拓扑保真度（节点、边、路径三个层次均提升10个点以上）。

papers.title: Chartographer: Counterfactual Chart Generation for Evaluating Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yifan Jiang, Dae Yon Hwang, Jesse C. Cresswell, Freda Shi
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Waterloo, Vector Institute, Layer 6 AI
papers.intro: 本文提出Chartographer框架，通过将图表逆向工程为可执行代码并生成种子控制的反事实图表变体，构建图表-问题家族，从而揭示VLMs在单一原始图表上正确回答但视觉证据变化后无法泛化的隐藏失败。

papers.title: How and What to Imagine? Visual Thinking in Unified Multimodal Models for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Qian Yang, Ankur Sikarwar, Huy Le, Le Zhang, Zhuan Shi, Perouz Taslakian, Aishwarya Agrawal
papers.tags: image generation, scene understanding, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Mila - Québec AI Institute; Université de Montréal; McGill University; ServiceNow AI Research; Canada CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 本文提出View Dropout（VDrop）训练干预，强制统一多模态模型（UMM）在跨视角空间推理中使用生成的思考图像，并通过可学性-信息性权衡框架比较了三种思考图像策略，发现全景视觉思考结合VDrop实现了最佳域外泛化。

papers.title: PlayClass: Automated Play Behaviour Classification in Poultry
papers.authors: Prince Ravi Leow, Neil Scheidwasser, Rebecca Oscarsson, Per Jensen, Samir Bhatt, David Alejandro Duchêne
papers.tags: object detection, tracking, Segment Anything, vision transformer, image classification
papers.affiliations: University of Copenhagen, Linköping University, Imperial College London
papers.intro: 本文提出PlayClass管道，结合SAM 3长视频跟踪（YOLO引导分块）和冻结视频/图像基础模型嵌入，在家禽顶视视频中实现个体级玩耍行为分类，其中V-JEPA 2.1结合手工运动特征在严重类不平衡数据集上达到77.0 macro F1。

papers.title: Rethinking Weakly-supervised Video Temporal Grounding From a Game Perspective
papers.authors: Xiang Fang, Zeyu Xiong, Wanlong Fang, Xiaoye Qu, Chen Chen, Jianfeng Dong, Keke Tang, Pan Zhou, Yu Cheng, Daizong Liu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学、中佛罗里达大学、浙江工商大学、广州大学、香港中文大学、北京大学
papers.intro: 本文首次从博弈论视角重新审视弱监督视频时间定位任务，将视频帧和查询词建模为博弈玩家，通过多元合作博弈理论学习帧-词间细粒度的不确定跨模态对应关系，从而无需时刻提案即可实现精确的时刻定位。

papers.title: EVIDENT: Routing MLLM Adaptation through Entity-Grounded Visual Evidence for Cross-Domain Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Geo Ahn, Jiwook Han, Youngrae Kim, Joonseok Lee, Jinwoo Choi
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation, tracking
papers.affiliations: Kyung Hee University, University of Southern California, Seoul National University
papers.intro: 本文提出EVIDENT框架，通过实体瓶颈适配器、实体绑定蒸馏和实体到证据门控机制，将VTG微调锚定在预训练MLLM固有的实体注意力能力上，以实体级视觉证据驱动时间定位，从而显著提升跨域鲁棒性。

papers.title: STORM: Internalized Modeling for Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models
papers.authors: Yiming Liang, Yixiao Chen, Yiyang Zhou, Yixuan Wang, Shoubin Yu, Andong Deng, Fuxiao Liu, Qin Zhang, Chen Chen, Mohit Bansal, Huaxiu Yao
papers.affiliations: Purdue University, Harvard University, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, University of Central Florida, NVIDIA, Physion Labs（按作者脚注顺序）
papers.intro: STORM提出了一种两阶段训练框架，通过训练阶段用生成的思想视频对潜在token进行动态监督，并在推理阶段仅通过有界潜轨迹进行内部化时空推理，从而在不使用外部工具也不显式生成中间视频的情况下提升视频推理准确率并大幅降低推理开销。

papers.title: TempRet: Temporal Enhancement and Two-Stage Reranking for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval Challenge
papers.authors: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Xiaowei Zhu, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie
papers.affiliations: Shandong University; Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen)
papers.intro: TempRet是一个面向EPIC-KITCHENS-100多实例检索的CLIP基双编码器系统，通过在视频端引入时间Transformer并在推理时使用两阶段重排序（双编码器粗检索+交叉编码器ITM精细重排），结合对软标签感知的对称多相似性损失，在V2T和T2V双方向取得了领先的平均mAP与nDCG。

papers.title: Geo-Align: Video Generation Alignment via Metric Geometry Reward
papers.authors: Zizun Li, Haoyu Guo, Runzhe Teng, Chunhua Shen, Tong He
papers.affiliations: USTC（中国科学技术大学）、Shanghai AI Lab（上海人工智能实验室）、ZJU（浙江大学）
papers.intro: 本文提出Geo-Align，第一个针对相机控制视频重渲染的强化学习框架，通过可验证的度量几何奖励（旋转与平移误差）和审美奖励，结合跨域数据融合策略与Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），在不依赖配对多视角数据的情况下显著提升了轨迹跟随精度和视觉质量。

papers.title: PiD: Fast and High-Resolution Latent Decoding with Pixel Diffusion
papers.authors: Yifan Lu, Qi Wu, Jay Zhangjie Wu, Zian Wang, Huan Ling, Sanja Fidler, Xuanchi Ren
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA
papers.intro: PiD通过在像素空间进行条件扩散，将潜在解码与高分辨率上采样统一为单个生成模块，利用噪声感知适配器和DMD2蒸馏实现快速、高质量、高分辨率的潜在解码。

papers.title: ETCHR: Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning
papers.authors: Beichen Zhang, Yuhong Liu, Jinsong Li, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang, Dahua Lin
papers.tags: image generation, object detection, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, CPII under InnoHK
papers.intro: 本文提出ETCHR，一种将专用图像编辑模型与理解模型解耦、通过两阶段训练（推理模仿+推理增强）和编辑-验证-推理流程实现问题条件化、推理感知的图像编辑方法，显著提升了多种MLLM在细粒度感知、图表、逻辑、拼图和3D推理任务上的Pass@1指标。

papers.title: Good Token Hunting: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers
papers.authors: Shuhong Zheng, Michael Oechsle, Erik Sandström, Marie-Julie Rakotosaona, Federico Tombari, Igor Gilitschenski
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, vision transformer, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: University of Toronto & Vector Institute（Shuhong Zheng, Igor Gilitschenski）；Google（Michael Oechsle, Erik Sandström, Marie-Julie Rakotosaona, Federico Tombari）；Technical University of Munich（Federico Tombari）
papers.intro: 本文提出GoToHunt，一种两阶段层次化token选择策略（帧间选择+帧内选择），在不需重新训练的情况下大幅加速视觉几何变换器，在500帧场景中实现超过85%的速度提升并保持甚至提升基线性能。

papers.title: Smart-Insertion-V: Photorealistic Video Insertion via a Closed-Loop Feedback Dual-Stream Framework
papers.authors: Xiao Cao, Yansong Qu, Xiangzhen, Chang, Wen Xiao, Jiakui Hu, Heyuan Li, Jialun Liu, Zhiyong Huang, Xuelong Li
papers.intro: 本文提出Smart-Insertion-V，一个基于闭循环反馈的双流框架，通过同步进行视频插入和图像风格迁移，并结合解耦引导模块和双视角Rotary Position Encoding，实现了无掩码的、风格和谐的参考物体视频插入。

papers.title: HorizonStream: Long-Horizon Attention for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Chong Cheng, Peilin Tao, Nanjie Yao, Guanzhi Ding, Xianda Chen, Yuansen Du, Xiaoyang Guo, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Zhengqing Chen, Hao Wang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, pose estimation, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: HKUST(GZ), Horizon Robotics, CASIA, CSU
papers.intro: 本文提出HorizonStream，通过将几何传播形式化为“证据影响核”并显式分解为长程时间因子和短程空间因子，利用通道级衰减率和有界局部注意力，实现48帧训练即可稳定泛化至超过10,000帧的在线3D重建。

papers.title: PGT: Procedurally Generated Tasks for improving visual grounding in MLLMs
papers.authors: Rim Assouel, Amir Bar, Michal Drozdzal, Adriana Romero-Soriano
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, scene understanding, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Mila - Québec AI Institute / Université de Montréal / FAIR at Meta Superintelligence Labs / McGill University / Canada CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 本文提出程序化生成任务（PGT），通过在真实图像上叠加抽象几何图元（如彩色边框、点、圆圈）生成密集可验证的监督信号，强制模型进行视觉定位，显著提升MLLMs在细粒度空间理解上的表现，并证明许多空间推理缺陷源于训练信号不足而非架构限制。

papers.title: LaMo: Self-Supervised Latent Motion Priors for Physical Realism in Video Generation
papers.authors: Bo Jiang, Depu Meng, Yihan Hu, Yichen Xie, Tianshuo Xu, Wei Zhan
papers.affiliations: Applied Intuition; University of California, Berkeley
papers.intro: LaMo提出了一种自监督的潜在运动先验，通过从无标签视频中提取帧间潜在变化来提升视频扩散模型的物理真实性，无需外部物理知识，并通过训练时的运动漂移损失和采样时的运动先验指导两条轻量级路径实现。

papers.title: Vision Transformers Need Better Token Interaction
papers.authors: Linxiang Su
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, depth estimation, image classification, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: University of Szeged
papers.intro: 论文揭示ViT中密集退化源于“语义扩散”（semantic diffusion）这一优化捷径，并提出用entmax-1.5稀疏注意力替代softmax注意力，在保持全局连接的同时增强令牌交互选择性，从而在不牺牲图像级识别性能的前提下显著提升密集预测（尤其语义分割）效果。

papers.title: Leveraging Foundation Models for Causal Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Aneesh Komanduri, Xintao Wu
papers.affiliations: University of Arkansas
papers.intro: 本文提出FM-CGM——一个利用预训练推理VLM和文本到图像扩散模型进行零样本视觉因果推理的模块化框架，通过因果语义引导（CSG）实现忠实的反事实图像生成。

papers.title: RE-TRIANGLE: Does TRIANGLE Enable Multimodal Alignment Beyond Cosine Similarity in Retrieval?
papers.authors: Arijit Ghosh, Aritra Bandyopadhyay, Chiranjeev Bindra, Jingfen Qiao
papers.affiliations: University of Amsterdam
papers.intro: 本文通过系统复现实验验证了TRIANGLE几何对齐目标在多模态检索中的有效性，确认其在零样本视频和音频检索上优于成对基线，但发现该目标对领域分布敏感、从头训练不稳定、且不同评估指标下表现不一致。

papers.title: CaST-Bench: Benchmarking Causal Chain-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Mingfang Zhang, Jingjing Pan, Ashutosh Kumar, Rajat Saini, Mustafa Erdogan, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Caixin Kang, Yifei Huang, Yoichi Sato, Quan Kong
papers.tags: video segmentation, visual grounding, multimodal learning, video generation, video search
papers.affiliations: Woven by Toyota, The University of Tokyo
papers.intro: CaST-Bench是一个全新的视频问答基准，通过提供带时间戳和边界框轨迹的链式时空因果证据，首次实现了对视觉语言模型因果链接地时空推理能力的严格评估。

papers.title: CoReVAD: A Contextual Reasoning Framework for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Hyeongmuk Lim, Youngbum Hur
papers.affiliations: Department of Industrial Engineering, Inha University, Incheon, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: CoReVAD提出一种基于单个冻结VLM的训练-free视频异常检测框架，通过局部响应清洗和全局上下文细化，直接生成异常分数与时间描述，实现高效且可解释的异常检测。

papers.title: Cambrian-P: Pose-Grounded Video Understanding
papers.authors: Jihan Yang, Zifan Zhao, Xichen Pan, Shusheng Yang, Junyi Zhang, Bingyi Kang, Hu Xu, Saining Xie
papers.affiliations: New York University, UC Berkeley, Meta FAIR
papers.intro: 本文提出 Cambrian-P，通过在视频多模态大模型中引入每帧可学习的相机位姿标记（camera tokens）和位姿回归头，实现了基于位姿的视频理解，在空间推理VQA上获得显著提升，并作为副产物在实时位姿估计上达到最优。

papers.title: Cambrian-P: Pose-Grounded Video Understanding
papers.authors: Jihan Yang, Zifan Zhao, Xichen Pan, Shusheng Yang, Junyi Zhang, Bingyi Kang, Hu Xu, Shang-Wen Li, Saining Xie
papers.affiliations: New York University; UC Berkeley; Meta FAIR
papers.intro: Cambrian-P通过为视频MLLM引入逐帧可学习的相机姿态令牌和姿态回归头，以轻量级姿态监督显著提升了空间推理和通用视频QA性能，同时实现了流式相机姿态估计的最先进结果。

papers.title: MotiMotion: Motion-Controlled Video Generation with Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Lee Hsin-Ying, Hanwen Jiang, Yiqun Mei, Jing Shi, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Zhixin Shu
papers.affiliations: University of California, Merced / Adobe Research
papers.intro: 本文提出MotiMotion，一个将运动控制重构为“推理‑生成”问题的框架，利用免训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）推理器细化稀疏用户输入并规划合理的次级运动，再通过置信度感知控制调节轨迹引导强度，从而生成因果一致、物理合理的交互视频。

papers.title: AwareVLN: Reasoning with Self-awareness for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Wenxuan Guo, Xiuwei Xu, Yichen Liu, Xiangyu Li, Hang Yin, Huangxing Chen, Wenzhao Zheng, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, China
papers.intro: AwareVLN通过引入一种在关键导航节点触发的结构化自我意识推理机制和自动数据引擎，使VLN模型在保持端到端数据驱动的同时，具备显式的进度感知、错误修正和可解释规划能力，显著超越现有方法。

papers.title: Sensor2Sensor: Cross-Embodiment Sensor Conversion for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jiahao Wang, Bo Sun, Yijing Bai, Vincent Casser, Songyou Peng, Zehao Zhu, Meng-Li Shih, Xander Masotto, Shih-Yang Su, Kanaad V Parvate, Tiancheng Ge, Linn Bieske, Dragomir Anguelov, Mingxing Tan, Chiyu Max Jiang
papers.affiliations: Waymo（主要），合作机构包括Johns Hopkins University, Google DeepMind, University of Washington
papers.intro: Sensor2Sensor 提出一种跨实体传感器转换范式，利用4D Gaussian Splatting重建AV日志生成配对训练数据，再使用条件扩散模型同时生成多视角图像和LiDAR，从而将野外单目行车记录仪视频转换为高保真多模态传感器日志。

papers.title: DecQ: Detail-Condensing Queries for Enhanced Reconstruction and Generation in Representation Autoencoders
papers.authors: Tianhang Wang, Yitong Chen, Wei Song, Zuxuan Wu, Min Li, Jiaqi Wang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Fudan University, Westlake University, JD.COM
papers.intro: DecQ通过在冻结VFM的中间层上附加少量可学习查询（detail-condensing queries），经交叉注意力提取浅层和深层细粒度特征，在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下，同时显著提升重建质量和生成性能，解耦了RAE中固有的重建-生成权衡。

papers.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
papers.authors: Jung Yi, Minjae Kim, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Wooseok Jang, Sangdoo Yun, Seungryong Kim
papers.affiliations: KAIST AI, Naver AI Lab
papers.intro: 本文提出WorldKV，一种无需训练的框架，通过世界检索（基于相机/动作相关性有效召回历史KV缓存）和世界压缩（基于键-键相似性修剪冗余标记）两个组件，在保持实时推理吞吐量的同时匹配或超越全KV缓存的长期记忆保真度。

papers.title: Conceptualizing Embeddings: Sparse Disentanglement for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Piotr Kubaty, Patryk Marszałek, Łukasz Struski, Adam Wróbel, Jacek Tabor, Marek Śmieja
papers.affiliations: Jagiellonian University, Warsaw University of Technology
papers.intro: 提出CEDAR，一种无需增加维度、通过可逆变换与top-k稀疏瓶颈对预训练视觉语言嵌入进行后处理解耦的方法，使语义信息集中到轴对齐的少量坐标上，兼顾重建保真度与人类可解释性。

papers.title: Slimmable ConvNeXt: Width-Adaptive Inference for Efficient Multi-Device Deployment
papers.authors: Janek Haberer, Jon Eike Wilhelm, Olaf Landsiedel
papers.affiliations: Kiel University, Germany; Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH), Germany; UNU-INWEH, Germany
papers.intro: 论文提出Slimmable ConvNeXt，利用ConvNeXt的现代设计（层归一化和反转瓶颈结构）实现无需可切换归一化的宽度自适应推理，在ImageNet-1k上以更低的计算量（GMACs）达到超越现有ViT和CNN可扩展方法的精度。

papers.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Javad Rajabi, Kimia Shaban, Koorosh Roohi, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: University of Toronto, Vector Institute
papers.intro: 提出SEGA，一种无训练、内容感知的动态注意力缩放方法，通过在每个去噪步骤分析潜变量的空间-频谱结构来逐维度调节RoPE缩放，从而同时改善高分辨率生成的结构连贯性和细节保真度。

papers.title: What Does the Caption Really Say? Counterfactual Phrase Intervention for Compositional Data Selection in Vision-Language Pretraining
papers.authors: Hyejin Go, Semi Lee, Hyesong Choi
papers.affiliations: Soongsil University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出Counterfactual Phrase Intervention（CPI），一种短语级别的数据筛选框架，通过受控的非词替换生成图像条件下的短语敏感度分数，用于从全局对齐池中选择短语级支持更强的图文对，在不修改目标函数的情况下提升组合性预训练效果。

papers.title: Foresee-to-Ground: From Predictive Temporal Perception to Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Zelin Zheng, Xinyan Liu, Ruixin Li, Antoni B. Chan, Guorong Li, Qingming Huang, Laiyun Qing
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Harbin Institute of Technology, Weihai; City University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: F2G将视频时间定位重构为可验证的"先识别后测量"（Identify-then-Measure）问题，通过预测性时间感知构建候选事件段证据池，并让LLM基于可引用的证据单元进行边界预测，从而将黑盒时间戳回归转变为结构化、可归因的推理过程。

papers.title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues
papers.authors: Dazhao Du, Liao Duan, Jian Liu, Tao Han, Yujia Zhang, Eric Liu, Xi Chen, Song Guo
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Tencent
papers.intro: 本文通过注意力头敲除实验发现MLLMs中存在稀疏的"时间定位头"（TG-Heads），揭示了模型在预填充阶段已知道正确时间区间但在解码阶段丢失该信号的"感知-生成鸿沟"，并提出一个无需参数更新的推理时"读取-再生成"框架来恢复这一隐藏信号，从而提升视频时间定位精度。

papers.title: MM-Conv: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Context-Aware Grounding in 3D Dialogue
papers.authors: Anna Deichler, Jim O'Regan, Fethiye Irmak Dogan, Lubos Marcinek, Anna Klezovich, Iolanda Leite, Jonas Beskow
papers.affiliations: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden
papers.intro: 该论文构建了一个包含6.7小时VR沉浸式对话的多模态数据集（4,211个引用表达式），并提出一个先进行对话歧义消除再进行视觉定位的模块化两阶段接地管道，相较端到端方法在代词等模糊引用上性能提升近一倍。

papers.title: SceneGraphGrounder: Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding via Structured Scene Graph Matching
papers.authors: Xuefei Sun, Xujia Zhang, Brendan Crowe, Doncey Albin, Christoffer Heckman
papers.affiliations: University of Colorado Boulder
papers.intro: 提出SceneGraphGrounder框架，将3D视觉定位重构为查询图与重建3D场景图之间的结构化图匹配问题，通过视觉标记提示策略从2D视图提取关系并提升为持久3D场景图，实现零样本、可解释的定位。

papers.title: Improving 3D Labeling in Self-Driving by Inferring Vehicle Information using Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Steven Chen, Shivesh Khaitan, Nemanja Djuric
papers.affiliations: Aurora Innovation, Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于VLM的零样本方法，通过单个前向推理同时完成车辆制造/型号/代际识别（VMMGR）和3D尺寸推断，为手动标注生成更准确的种子3D边框，从而提升自动驾驶标注流程的效率和质量。

papers.title: BEiTScore: Reference-free Image Captioning Evaluation with an Efficient Cross-Encoder Model
papers.authors: Gonçalo Gomes, Bruno Martins, Chrysoula Zerva
papers.affiliations: Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon; INESC-ID; Instituto de Telecomunicações
papers.intro: 提出BEiTScore，一个基于轻量级交叉编码器（从VQA检查点初始化）的无参考图像描述评估指标，结合对抗性LLM数据增强和两阶段训练，在多个基准上达到与LLM指标相当甚至更优的与人类判断的相关性，同时推理速度快30-100倍、模型轻20-60倍。

papers.title: AVI-HT: Adaptive Vision-IMU Fusion for 3D Hand Tracking
papers.authors: Ziyi Kou, Ankit Kumar, Mia Huang, Taylor Niehues, Vatsal Mehta, Ergys Ristani, Li Guan
papers.affiliations: Meta Reality Labs
papers.intro: 本文提出AVI-HT，一种通过跨传感器深度注意力机制自适应融合第一人称视觉与手套上6-DoF IMU信号的方法，在手物交互场景下比纯视觉方法显著降低了3D关键点误差。

papers.title: Hierarchical Variational Policies for Reward-Guided Diffusion
papers.authors: Kushagra Pandey, Farrin Marouf Sofian, Jan Niklas Groeneveld, Felix Draxler, Stephan Mandt
papers.affiliations: University of California Irvine
papers.intro: 通过将扩散模型的测试时引导重新表述为层次变分模型，将控制摊销到轻量级随机策略中，实现少步采样并保持高质量，从而在感知质量与推理速度之间取得显著优于现有测试时缩放基线的权衡。

papers.title: Look-Closer-Then-Diagnose: Confidence-Aware Ultrasound VQA via Active Zooming
papers.authors: Yue Zhou, Erxuan Wu, Yikang Sun, Hongjoo Lee, Yuan Bi, Huixiong Xu, Zhongliang Jiang
papers.affiliations: 未明确（各作者所属机构不同，见"作者机构"部分）
papers.intro: 本文提出一个模拟超声医生认知流程的框架，通过"缩放到病灶再诊断"（Zoom-then-Diagnose）范式和基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的不确定性感知奖励，实现病灶聚焦推理与置信度对齐。

papers.title: Ablate-to-Validate: Are Vision-Language Models Really Using Continuous Thought Tokens?
papers.authors: Tianyi Zhang, Mahtab Bigverdi, Ranjay Krishna
papers.affiliations: University of Washington
papers.intro: 本文提出 Token Replacement Test（TRT），通过系统性地替换连续视觉 token 内容（零、随机、首重复、真值等）来诊断 VLM 是否真正利用 token 信息，并在多个 backbone 和现成系统上发现准确率提升是误导性代理——模型几乎不依赖 token 内容。

papers.title: Flat-Pack Bench: Evaluating Spatio-Temporal Understanding in Large Vision-Language Models through Furniture Assembly
papers.authors: Aditya Chetan, Eric Cai, Peeyush Kushwaha, Bharath Raj Nagoor Kani, Utkarsh Mall, Qianqian Wang, Noah Snavely, Bharath Hariharan
papers.affiliations: Cornell University, Cornell Tech, MBZUAI, UC Berkeley, Independent researcher
papers.intro: 提出Flat-Pack Bench，一个以家具组装视频为中心的基准，通过四种精细时空推理任务（时序排序、时序定位、部件对接和跟踪）系统评估大型视觉语言模型，揭示其远低于人类水平的严重不足。

papers.title: UniVL: Unified Vision-Language Embedding for Spatially Grounded Contextual Image Generation
papers.authors: Jiayun Wang, Yu Wang, Weijie Gan, Zhenting Wang, Wei Wei
papers.tags: image generation, text-to-image, image-to-image, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Center for Advanced AI, Accenture
papers.intro: 提出UniVL框架，通过将文本标签直接渲染到掩码区域形成统一视觉条件，利用OCR预训练的视觉编码器生成融合语义与空间位置的UniVL嵌入（fVL），以两阶段训练对齐和微调扩散模型，完全消除独立的文本编码器，实现高效且空间精确的上下文图像生成。

papers.title: MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
papers.authors: Yujie Wei, Yujin Han, Zhekai Chen, Yongming Li, Kaixun Jiang, Zhihang Liu, Quanhao Li, Zhiwu Qing, Xiang Wang, Zhen Xing, Ruihang Chu, Lingyi Hong, Yefei He, Junjie Zhou, Junqiu Yu, Yang Shi, Difan Zou, Kai Zhu, Shiwei Zhang, Yingya Zhang, Yu Liu, Xihui Liu, Hongming Shan
papers.affiliations: Fudan University, The University of Hong Kong, Tongyi Lab (Alibaba Group), Zhejiang University, Peking University
papers.intro: 提出MSAVBench，第一个全面的多镜头音频-视频生成基准和自适应混合评估框架，覆盖视频、音频、镜头和参考四个维度，包含对19个最新闭源和开源模型的系统评估，与人类判断的Spearman秩相关达91.5%。

papers.title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Juncheng Wu, Hardy Chen, Haoqin Tu, Xianfeng Tang, Freda Shi, Hui Liu, Hanqing Lu, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou
papers.tags: Image Feature Extraction, object detection, image classification
papers.affiliations: 1Amazon, 2UC Santa Cruz, 3University of Waterloo, 4Vector Institute, Canada CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 本文提出一种能力级别的阶段性后训练框架，将VLM的训练解耦为视觉感知、文本推理和视觉推理三个阶段，发现视觉感知需要专用数据、分阶段先于推理训练且更适合用RL而非SFT，从而提升整体性能并缩短推理痕迹。

papers.title: Multi-axis Analysis of Image Manipulation Localization
papers.authors: Keanu Nichols, Divya Appapogu, Giscard Biamby, Dina Bashkirova, Anna Rohrbach, Bryan A. Plummer
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, image classification, Image Feature Extraction, Mask Generation
papers.affiliations: Boston University, University of California, Berkeley, Technical University of Darmstadt & hessian.AI, Google
papers.intro: 本文提出AUDITS，一个大规模、多轴（域、质量、类型、大小）的图像篡改定位基准，涵盖超过53万张来自两个域、11种扩散篡改技术的图像，并发现现有方法在域迁移时性能显著下降且域泛化技术无法改善，突显了该领域的重大挑战。

papers.title: CaMo: Camera Motion Grounded Evaluation and Training for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Hsiang-Wei Huang, Junbin Lu, Kuang-Ming Chen, Jianxu Shangguan, Cheng-Yen Yang, Jenq-Neng Hwang
papers.affiliations: University of Washington
papers.intro: 本文提出Spatial Narrative Score (SNS)诊断性评估框架和CaMo-30K训练数据集，通过显式监督相机运动理解，训练出CaMo-3B模型，实现在直接问答和SNS评估上一致的空间理解性能，揭示了现有空间VLM依赖捷径学习的现象。

papers.title: Rethinking Visual Attribution for Chest X-ray Reasoning in Large Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Guangzhi Xiong, Qiao Jin, Sanchit Sinha, Zhiyong Lu, Aidong Zhang
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Image Feature Extraction, image classification, image-to-image, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Virginia, National Institutes of Health
papers.intro: 本文提出一种因果评估框架（MedGround-Bench）证明现有归因方法在胸部X光推理中普遍无法忠实定位LVLM的视觉证据，并设计了一种基于概念的部分最优传输干预归因方法（MedFocus），在空间、概念和词元三个层面显著提升归因忠实性。

papers.title: PixVerve: Advancing Native UHR Image Generation to 100MP with a Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset
papers.authors: Haojun Chen, Haoyang He, Chengming Xu, Qingdong He, Junwei Zhu, Yabiao Wang, Zhucun Xue, Xianfang Zeng, Zhennan Chen, Xiaobin Hu, Hao Zhao, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang, Dacheng Tao
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Haojun Chen - 浙江大学, Haoyang He - 浙江大学, Chengming Xu - 复旦大学, Qingdong He - 浙江大学, Junwei Zhu - 南京大学, Yabiao Wang - 浙江大学, Zhucun Xue - 浙江大学, Xianfang Zeng - 浙江大学, Zhennan Chen - 南京大学, Xiaobin Hu - 新加坡国立大学, Hao Zhao - 清华大学, Yong Liu - 浙江大学, Jiangning Zhang - 浙江大学, Dacheng Tao - 南洋理工大学
papers.intro: 本文提出了PixVerve-95K——首个大规模高质量100MP T2I数据集，并基于该数据集探索了多种原生100MP图像生成训练方案，同时构建了PixVerve-Bench评估基准，系统推进了超高清文本到图像生成。

papers.title: SetCon: Towards Open-Ended Referring Segmentation via Set-Level Concept Prediction
papers.authors: Zhixiong Zhang, Yizhuo Li, Shuangrui Ding, Yuhang Zang, Shengyuan Ding, Long Xing, Yibin Wang, Qiaosheng Zhang, Jiaqi Wang
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University, University of Science and Technology of China
papers.intro: 本文提出SetCon，通过将开放式指代分割重新定义为显式的集合级概念预测，利用LVLM生成的自然语言概念（而非特殊token）作为语义条件进行联合掩码集解码，并引入层级语义分解以处理跨类别场景。

papers.title: MetaEarth-MM: Unified Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Generation with Scene-centered Joint Modeling
papers.authors: Zhiping Yu, Chenyang Liu, Jinqi Cao, Qinzhe Yang, Siwei Yu, Zhengxia Zou, Zhenwei Shi
papers.tags: image generation, image-to-image, Image Feature Extraction, image classification
papers.affiliations: Beihang University (北京航空航天大学)
papers.intro: 本文提出MetaEarth-MM，一个基于场景中心联合建模的统一多模态遥感图像生成基础模型，在流匹配框架下通过解耦的架构（场景推理模块+模态感知路由生成器）实现五种模态（RGB、SAR、NIR、PAN、OSM）的联合生成与任意翻译，并构建了包含280万图像的EarthMM数据集。

papers.title: VL-DPO: Vision-Language-Guided Finetuning for Preference-Aligned Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Zhefan Xu, Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University (Zhefan Xu), Waymo (Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat)
papers.intro: 本文提出VL-DPO，利用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为零样本推理器，自动生成轨迹偏好对，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）微调运动预测模型，实现与人类驾驶偏好的有效对齐。

papers.title: Probability-Conserving Flow Guidance
papers.authors: Parsa Esmati, Junha Hyung, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Jaegul Choo, Majid Mirmehdi
papers.affiliations: University of Bristol (Parsa Esmati, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Majid Mirmehdi), KAIST (Junha Hyung, Jaegul Choo)
papers.intro: 本文从概率守恒的连续性方程出发，将引导项分解为散度项和分数平行项，提出自适应流形引导（AdaMaG）的即插即用采样规则，通过对两者进行约束（分数平行阻尼+晚期时间衰减）来保持轨迹在流形上，从而在无额外推理成本下改善生成质量。

papers.title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding
papers.authors: Gueter Josmy Faure, Min-Hung Chen, Jia-Fong Yeh, Hung-Ting Su, Winston H. Hsu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, visual question answering, video search
papers.affiliations: National Taiwan University, Google, Independent Researcher
papers.intro: 本文提出了FineBench——一个包含199,420个QA对、基于64个长视频的密集标注人类中心视频问答基准，并提出了FineAgent模块化框架，通过Localizer和Descriptor组件显著提升开放源码VLMs在细粒度人类活动理解上的表现。

papers.title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Jinbiao Wei, Qianran Ma, Yilun Zhao, Xiao Zhou, Kangqi Ni, Guo Gan, Arman Cohan
papers.affiliations: Yale NLP Lab (Yale University), University of Pennsylvania, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

papers.title: Artifact-Bench: Evaluating MLLMs on Detecting and Assessing the Artifacts of AI-Generated Videos

papers.title: Harnessing Self-Supervised Features for Art Classification

papers.title: Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent

papers.title: MementoGUI: Learning Agentic Multimodal Memory Control for Long-Horizon GUI Agents

papers.title: CurveBench: A Benchmark for Exact Topological Reasoning over Nested Jordan Curves
papers.authors: Amirreza Mohseni, Mona Mohammadi, Morteza Saghafian, Naser Talebizadeh Sardari
papers.affiliations: Maastricht University, Cornell University, TU Wien, Pennsylvania State University
papers.intro: 提出 CurveBench——一个用于评估视觉语言模型从互不相交 Jordan 曲线图像中精确恢复嵌套包含树（根化树）能力的基准，并通过 RLVR 风格的强化学习微调开源 VLM 显著提升其性能，但最难的测试子集仍远未解决。

papers.title: Bad Seeing or Bad Thinking? Rewarding Perception for Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.authors: Haozhe Wang, Qixin Xu, Changpeng Wang, Taofeng Xue, Chong Peng, Wenhu Chen, Fangzhen Lin
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), Tsinghua University, Zhejiang University, Meituan, China, University of Waterloo
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的模态感知信用分配机制（MoCA），通过强制将VLM生成过程解耦为感知和推理步骤，并引入“盲眼推理”代理和结构化语言验证来分别奖励感知质量和最终回答，从而有效缓解了感知与推理的“跷跷板效应”。

papers.title: Evolving Layer-Specific Scalar Functions for Hardware-Aware Transformer Adaptation
papers.authors: Kieran Carrigg, Sigur de Vries, Amirhossein Sadough, Marcel van Gerven
papers.tags: image classification, vision transformer, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition, and Behaviour
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于遗传编程的框架，为预训练ViT逐层进化异质标量函数替代LayerNorm，并结合后训练重对齐策略，在仅20个epoch内恢复84.25% ImageNet Top-1准确率，有效消除了全局归约瓶颈，改善了硬件部署效率。

papers.title: PVRF: All-in-one Adverse Weather Removal via Prior-modulated and Velocity-constrained Rectified Flow
papers.authors: Wei Dong, Han Zhou, Terry Ji, Guanhua Zhao, Shahab Asoodeh, Yulun Zhang, Guangtao Zhai, Jun Chen, Xiaohong Liu
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: McMaster University (Wei Dong, Han Zhou, Terry Ji, Guanhua Zhao, Shahab Asoodeh, Jun Chen); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Yulun Zhang, Guangtao Zhai, Xiaohong Liu)
papers.intro: 提出PVRF，一个统一框架，通过零样本软天气感知（来自冻结VLM）引导的失真恢复网络和速度约束的修正流模型，同时提升保真度和感知质量，实现对所有类型恶劣天气（包括混合退化）的鲁棒去除。

papers.title: Masked Autoencoders with Limited Data: Does It Work? A Fine-Grained Bioacoustics Case Study
papers.authors: Wuao Liu, Mustafa Chasmai, Subhransu Maji, Grant Van Horn
papers.affiliations: University of Massachusetts Amherst
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了掩码自编码器（MAE）在中等规模、弱标注的细粒度生物声学数据集（iNatSounds）上的预训练效果，发现预训练数据规模远比目标设计或额外领域特化预训练更重要，且领域特化继续预训练或选择性数据筛选带来的收益有限甚至为负。

papers.title: Unified Pix Token And Word Token Generative Language Model
papers.authors: Haun Leung, ZiNan Wang
papers.intro: 本文提出一种统一像素令牌（pix token）和文字令牌（word token）的生成式语言模型，通过为每个像素赋予独立可调的token embedding、颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似和图像无监督预训练，实现了无需ViT编码器的视觉与语言统一生成。

papers.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
papers.authors: Haiwen Diao, Penghao Wu, Hanming Deng, Jiahao Wang, Shihao Bai, Silei Wu, Weichen Fan, Wenjie Ye, Wenwen Tong, Xiangyu Fan, Yan Li, Yubo Wang, Zhijie Cao, Zhiqian Lin, Zhitao Yang, Zhongang Cai, Yuwei Niu, Yue Zhu, Bo Liu, Chengguang Lv, Haojia Yu, Haozhe Xie, Hongli Wang, Jianan Fan, Jiaqi Li, Jiefan Lu, Jingcheng Ni, Junxiang Xu, Kaihuan Liang, Lianqiang Shi, Linjun Dai, Linyan Wang, Oscar Qian, Peng Gao, Pengfei Liu, Qingping Sun, Rui Shen, Ruisi Wang, Shengnan Ma, Shuang Yang, Siyi Xie, Siying Li, Tianbo Zhong, Xiangli Kong, Xuanke Shi, Yang Gao, Yongqiang Yao, Yves Wang, Zhengqi Bai, Zhengyu Lin, Zixin Yin, Wenxiu Sun, Ruihao Gong, Quan Wang, Lewei Lu, Lei Yang, Ziwei Liu, Dahua Lin
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文正文第一页未提供作者机构信息）
papers.intro: SenseNova-U1基于NEO-unify架构，通过近无损视觉接口、原生端到端统一建模和原生混合物变换器（MoT）架构，首次实现无需预训练视觉编码器或VAE的理解-生成一体化多模态模型，在两个变体上达到甚至超越顶尖理解专用模型，同时具备强大的任意到图像合成、图文交错生成能力，并初步展现视觉-语言…

papers.title: CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives
papers.authors: Yihao Meng, Zichen Liu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Ka Leong Cheng, Yue Yu, Hanlin Wang, Haobo Li, Jiapeng Zhu, Yanhong Zeng, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Qifeng Chen, Huamin Qu
papers.affiliations: HKUST, Ant Group, SJTU

papers.title: Revisiting Photometric Ambiguity for Accurate Gaussian-Splatting Surface Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jiahe Li, Jiawei Zhang, Xiao Bai, Jin Zheng, Xiaohan Yu, Lin Gu, Gim Hee Lee
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Beihang University, National University of Singapore, Macquarie University, Tohoku University
papers.intro: 本文提出AmbiSuR框架，通过揭示Gaussian Splatting中的两种内建原始级光度歧义并引入消歧策略，同时利用球谐系数作为免费歧义自指示器以引导先验正则化，从而在多种挑战场景下实现高精度的表面重建。

papers.title: Elastic Attention Cores for Scalable Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Alan Z. Song, Yinjie Chen, Mu Nan, Rui Zhang, Jiahang Cao, Weijian Mai, Muquan Yu, Hossein Adeli, Deva Ramanan, Michael J. Tarr, Andrew F. Luo
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, University of Hong Kong, Columbia University
papers.intro: 提出VECA（Visual Elastic Core Attention）架构，用核心-外围（core-periphery）结构的线性时间注意力替代全自注意力，并通过嵌套训练实现弹性计算-精度权衡，在不直接依赖补丁间交互的前提下达到与前沿视觉基础模型竞争的性能。

papers.title: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Xuhao Hu, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Kyle Qiao, Jingyi Yang, Xuanjing Huang, Jing Shao, Ming Yan, Jieping Ye
papers.tags: gui, multimodal learning, visual grounding, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group（Xuhao Hu, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Kyle Qiao, Ming Yan, Jieping Ye）；Fudan University（Xuhao Hu, Jingyi Yang, Xuanjing Huang）；Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory（Jing Shao）

papers.title: OmniNFT: Modality-wise Omni Diffusion Reinforcement for Joint Audio-Video Generation
papers.authors: Guohui Zhang, XiaoXiao Ma, Jie Huang, Hang Xu, Hu Yu, Siming Fu, Yuming Li, Zeyue Xue, Lin Song, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Feng Zhao
papers.tags: video generation, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: 未明确（多个机构：University of Science and Technology of China, Peking University, JD Explore Academy，但未在基本信息字段中明确列出，需在作者机构部分详细说明）
papers.intro: 提出OmniNFT，一种模态感知的在线扩散强化学习框架，通过模态级优势路由、层级梯度手术和区域级损失重加权，解决联合音频-视频生成中多目标优化不一致、梯度失衡和均匀信用分配问题，在JavisBench和VBench上显著提升感知质量、跨模态对齐和音视频同步。

papers.title: FuTCR: Future-Targeted Contrast and Repulsion for Continual Panoptic Segmentation
papers.authors: Nicholas Ikechukwu, Keanu Nichols, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Bryan A. Plummer
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Mask Generation, object detection
papers.affiliations: Boston University, Runway

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Retrospective Dynamic Scene Novel View Synthesis with a Standardized Benchmark
papers.authors: Yunxiao Zhang, Suryansh Kumar
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, Video to Video, image-to-image

papers.title: GaitProtector: Impersonation-Driven Gait De-Identification via Training-Free Diffusion Latent Optimization

papers.intro: 本文提出GaitProtector，一种无需训练的视频扩散潜空间优化框架，通过结合混淆（repel源身份）和冒充（attract目标身份）的联合目标，在预训练3D扩散先验的引导下生成结构合理的受保护步态轮廓序列。

papers.title: AOI-SSL: Self-Supervised Framework for Efficient Segmentation of Wire-bonded Semiconductors In Optical Inspection
papers.authors: Joaquín Figueira, Rob Van Gastel, Giacomo D'Amicantonio, Zhuoran Liu, Ioan Gabriel Bucur, Faysal Boughorbel, Egor Bondarev

papers.title: Executable Agentic Memory for GUI Agent
papers.authors: Zerui Qin, Sheng Yue, Xingyuan Hua, Yongjian Fu, Ju Ren

papers.title: SkillGraph: Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Agents via Evolving Skill Graphs

papers.title: Multimodal Abstractive Summarization of Instructional Videos with Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Maham Nazir, Muhammad Aqeel, Richong Zhang, Francesco Setti

papers.title: CaC: Advancing Video Reward Models via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Concentrating
papers.authors: Jiyuan Wang, Huan Ouyang, Jiuzhou Lin, Chunyu Lin, Dewen Fan, Boheng Zhang, Haonan Fan, Fei Zuo, Jia Sun, Huaiqing Wang, Honglie Wang, Yiyang Fan, Zhenlong Yuan, Zijun Li, Yongrui Heng, Guosheng Lin, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao
papers.affiliations: 北京交通大学（BJTU）、南洋理工大学（NTU）、北京邮电大学（BUPT）、快手科技（Kuaishou Technology）

papers.title: Power Reinforcement Post-Training of Text-to-Image Models with Super-Linear Advantage Shaping
papers.authors: Haoyuan Sun, Jing Wang, Yuxin Song, Yu Lu, Bo Fang, Yifu Luo, Jun Yin, Pengyu Zeng, Miao Zhang, Tiantian Zhang, Xueqian Wang, Shijian Lu

papers.title: Personal Visual Context Learning in Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Zihui Xue, Ami Baid, Sangho Kim, Mi Luo, Kristen Grauman

papers.title: Pixal3D: Pixel-Aligned 3D Generation from Images

papers.title: Confidence-Guided Diffusion Augmentation for Enhanced Bangla Compound Character Recognition

papers.title: Counterfactual Stress Testing for Image Classification Models

papers.title: Count Anything at Any Granularity

papers.title: Geometry-aware Prototype Learning for Cross-domain Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation

papers.title: CADBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for AI-Assisted CAD Program Generation

papers.title: BenchCAD: A Comprehensive, Industry-Standard Benchmark for Programmatic CAD
papers.authors: Haozhe Zhang, Kaichen Liu, Miaomiao Chen, Lei Li, Shaojie Yang, Cheng Peng, Hanjie Chen

papers.title: Masked Generative Transformer Is What You Need for Image Editing
papers.authors: Wei Chow, Linfeng Li, Xian Sun, Lingdong Kong, Zefeng Li, Qi Xu, Hang Song, Tian Ye, Xian Wang, Jinbin Bai, Shilin Xu, Xiangtai Li, Junting Pan, Shaoteng Liu, Ran Zhou, Tianshu Yang, Songhua Liu

papers.title: MMVIAD: Multi-view Multi-task Video Understanding for Industrial Anomaly Detection

papers.title: OZ-TAL: Online Zero-Shot Temporal Action Localization

papers.title: ReCoVR: Closing the Loop in Interactive Composed Video Retrieval

papers.title: SpaceMind++: Toward Allocentric Cognitive Maps for Spatially Grounded Video MLLMs

papers.title: CREST: Curvature-Regulated Event-Centric Sampling for Efficient Long-Video Understanding

papers.title: SYNCR: A Cross-Video Reasoning Benchmark with Synthetic Grounding

papers.title: 123D: Unifying Multi-Modal Autonomous Driving Data at Scale

papers.title: Normalizing Trajectory Models

papers.title: EmambaIR: Efficient Visual State Space Model for Event-guided Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: Wei Yu, Yunhang Qian

papers.title: Proxy3D: Efficient 3D Representations for Vision-Language Models via Semantic Clustering and Alignment
papers.authors: Jerry Jiang, Haowen Sun, Denis Gudovskiy, Yohei Nakata, Tomoyuki Okuno, Kurt Keutzer, Wenzhao Zheng

papers.title: Flow-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models

papers.title: 6D Pose Estimation via Keypoint Heatmap Regression with RGB-D Residual Neural Networks
papers.authors: Ismail Aljosevic, Amir Masoud Almasi, Ana Parovic, Ashkan Shafiei

papers.title: SCOPE: Structured Decomposition and Conditional Skill Orchestration for Complex Image Generation
papers.authors: Tianfei Ren, Zhipeng Yan, Yiming Zhao, Zhen Fang, Yu Zeng, Guohui Zhang, Hang Xu, Xiaoxiao Ma, Shiting Huang, Ke Xu, Wenxuan Huang, Lionel Z. Wang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Jie Huang, Feng Zhao

papers.title: Object Hallucination-Free Reinforcement Unlearning for Vision-Language Models

papers.title: PET-Adapter: Test-Time Domain Adaptation for Full and Limited-Angle PET Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: Rüveyda Yilmaz, Yuli Wu, Johannes Stegmaier, Volkmar Schulz

papers.title: STARFlow2: Bridging Language Models and Normalizing Flows for Unified Multimodal Generation

papers.title: SphereVAD: Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Geodesic Inference on the Unit Hypersphere
papers.authors: Chao Huang, Penfei Wei, Wei Wang, Jie Wen, Zhihua Wang, Li Shen, Wenqi Ren, Xiaochun Cao

papers.title: UpstreamQA: A Modular Framework for Explicit Reasoning on Video Question Answering Tasks
papers.authors: Jason Nguyen, Ameet Rao, Alexander Chang, Ishaan Kumar, Erin Tan

papers.title: From Global to Local: Rethinking CLIP Feature Aggregation for Person Re-Identification

papers.title: Thinking Before Matching: A Reinforcement Reasoning Paradigm Towards General Person Re-Identification

papers.title: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents

papers.title: HABIT: Chrono-Synergia Robust Progressive Learning Framework for Composed Image Retrieval

papers.title: ReTrack: Evidence-Driven Dual-Stream Directional Anchor Calibration Network for Composed Video Retrieval

papers.title: On the Reliability of Computer Use Agents

papers.title: Towards Realistic Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation: Benchmark and Baseline

papers.title: Causal Bootstrapped Alignment for Unsupervised Video-Based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification

papers.title: GPT-4V(ision) is a Generalist Web Agent, if Grounded
papers.authors: Boyuan Zheng, Boyu Gou, Jihyung Kil, Huan Sun, Yu Su

papers.title: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users

papers.affiliations: Tencent

papers.title: ASSISTGUI: Task-Oriented Desktop Graphical User Interface Automation
papers.authors: Difei Gao, Lei Ji, Zechen Bai, Mingyu Ouyang, Peiran Li, Dongxing Mao, Qinchen Wu, Weichen Zhang, Peiyi Wang, Xiangwu Guo, Hengxu Wang, Luowei Zhou, Mike Zheng Shou

papers.title: CogAgent: A Visual Language Model for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Wenyi Hong, Weihan Wang, Qingsong Lv, Jiazheng Xu, Wenmeng Yu, Junhui Ji, Yan Wang, Zihan Wang, Yuxuan Zhang, Juanzi Li, Bin Xu, Yuxiao Dong, Ming Ding, Jie Tang

papers.title: TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal Large Language Model for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Shuhuai Ren, Linli Yao, Shicheng Li, Xu Sun, Lu Hou
papers.affiliations: 北京大学多媒体信息处理国家重点实验室（School of Computer Science, Peking University）；华为诺亚方舟实验室（Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab）

papers.title: Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall: Augmenting LLM with Human-like Memory for Mobile Task Automation
papers.authors: Sunjae Lee, Junyoung Choi, Jungjae Lee, Munim Hasan Wasi, Hojun Choi, Steven Y. Ko, Sangeun Oh, Insik Shin

papers.title: Symbol-LLM: Towards Foundational Symbol-centric Interface For Large Language Models
papers.authors: Fangzhi Xu, Zhiyong Wu, Qiushi Sun, Siyu Ren, Fei Yuan, Shuai Yuan, Qika Lin, Yu Qiao, Jun Liu

papers.title: GPT-4V in Wonderland: Large Multimodal Models for Zero-Shot Smartphone GUI Navigation
papers.authors: An Yan, Zhengyuan Yang, Wanrong Zhu, Kevin Lin, Linjie Li, Jianfeng Wang, Jianwei Yang, Yiwu Zhong, Julian McAuley, Jianfeng Gao, Zicheng Liu, Lijuan Wang

papers.title: OpenAgents: An Open Platform for Language Agents in the Wild
papers.authors: Tianbao Xie, Fan Zhou, Zhoujun Cheng, Peng Shi, Luoxuan Weng, Yitao Liu, Toh Jing Hua, Junning Zhao, Qian Liu, Che Liu, Leo Z. Liu, Yiheng Xu, Hongjin Su, Dongchan Shin, Caiming Xiong, Tao Yu

papers.title: Reinforced UI Instruction Grounding: Towards a Generic UI Task Automation API
papers.authors: Zhizheng Zhang, Wenxuan Xie, Xiaoyi Zhang, Yan Lu

papers.intro: 本文提出Reinforced UI Instruction Grounding（RUIG）模型，通过像素到序列范式结合策略梯度强化学习，实现仅凭指令和截图即可精准定位UI目标元素，可作为通用UI任务自动化API。

papers.title: Delving into CLIP latent space for Video Anomaly Recognition
papers.authors: Luca Zanella, Benedetta Liberatori, Willi Menapace, Fabio Poiesi, Yiming Wang, Elisa Ricci

papers.title: You Only Look at Screens: Multimodal Chain-of-Action Agents
papers.authors: Zhuosheng Zhang, Aston Zhang
papers.affiliations: Zhuosheng Zhang - School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Aston Zhang - GenAI, Meta

papers.title: LASER: LLM Agent with State-Space Exploration for Web Navigation
papers.authors: Kaixin Ma, Hongming Zhang, Hongwei Wang, Xiaoman Pan, Wenhao Yu, Dong Yu
papers.affiliations: Tencent AI Lab, Bellevue, WA

papers.title: AutoDroid: LLM-powered Task Automation in Android

papers.affiliations: 清华大学智能产业研究院（AIR），上海人工智能实验室，圣母大学计算机科学与工程系，微软研究院，清华大学全球创新学院及自动化系

papers.title: VadCLIP: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Peng Wu, Xuerong Zhou, Guansong Pang, Lingru Zhou, Qingsen Yan, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang

papers.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents

papers.title: A Real-World WebAgent with Planning, Long Context Understanding, and Program Synthesis

papers.title: Android in the Wild: A Large-Scale Dataset for Android Device Control

papers.title: Synapse: Trajectory-as-Exemplar Prompting with Memory for Computer Control

papers.title: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
papers.authors: Xiang Deng, Yu Gu, Boyuan Zheng, Shijie Chen, Samuel Stevens, Boshi Wang, Huan Sun, Yu Su

papers.title: Towards Unified Text-based Person Retrieval: A Large-scale Multi-Attribute and Language Search Benchmark

papers.title: SheetCopilot: Bringing Software Productivity to the Next Level through Large Language Models

papers.title: Augmenting Autotelic Agents with Large Language Models
papers.authors: Cédric Colas, Laetitia Teodorescu, Pierre-Yves Oudeyer, Xingdi Yuan, Marc-Alexandre Côté

papers.title: Mobile-Env: Building Qualified Evaluation Benchmarks for LLM-GUI Interaction

papers.title: Language Models can Solve Computer Tasks

papers.title: YOLOv6 v3.0: A Full-Scale Reloading

papers.title: SatlasPretrain: A Large-Scale Dataset for Remote Sensing Image Understanding

papers.title: OpenEarthMap: A Benchmark Dataset for Global High-Resolution Land Cover Mapping
papers.authors: Junshi Xia, Naoto Yokoya, Bruno Adriano, Clifford Broni-Bediako

papers.title: EISeg: An Efficient Interactive Segmentation Tool based on PaddlePaddle

papers.title: YOLOv6: A Single-Stage Object Detection Framework for Industrial Applications

papers.tags: tracking, object detection, video segmentation, autonomous driving, video search

papers.intro: 本文提出BoT-SORT和BoT-SORT-ReID两种新的跟踪器，通过改进Kalman滤波器状态向量、引入相机运动补偿（CMC）以及设计新颖的IoU-ReID融合方法，在MOT17和MOT20数据集上实现了所有主要MOT指标（MOTA、IDF1、HOTA）的最优性能。

papers.title: META-GUI: Towards Multi-modal Conversational Agents on Mobile GUI
papers.authors: Liangtai Sun, Xingyu Chen, Lu Chen, Tianle Dai, Zichen Zhu, Kai Yu
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 本文提出GUI-based任务导向对话（GUI-TOD）架构，构建META-GUI数据集（含多轮对话与GUI操作轨迹），并设计多模态模型预测GUI动作并生成响应，在真实安卓APP上验证其有效性。

papers.title: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking
papers.authors: Jinkun Cao, Jiangmiao Pang, Xinshuo Weng, Rawal Khirodkar, Kris Kitani
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nvidia
papers.intro: OC-SORT通过引入观测中心的重更新（ORU）和观测中心动量（OCM）两个模块，在不增加复杂度的前提下修复了SORT在遮挡期间KF误差累积的问题，实现了对遮挡和非线性运动场景的鲁棒跟踪，同时保持简单、在线和实时的特性。

papers.title: A data-driven approach for learning to control computers
papers.authors: Peter C Humphreys, David Raposo, Toby Pohlen, Gregory Thornton, Rachita Chhaparia, Alistair Muldal, Josh Abramson, Petko Georgiev, Alex Goldin, Adam Santoro, Timothy Lillicrap
papers.affiliations: DeepMind, London, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文提出一个统一人类-智能体界面的数据驱动方法，通过大规模人类演示数据（2.4M演示，6300小时）结合行为克隆和强化学习，在MiniWob++基准上达到人类级平均性能，并展示跨任务迁移能力。

papers.title: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility
papers.authors: Andrea Burns, Deniz Arsan, Sanjna Agrawal, Ranjitha Kumar, Kate Saenko, Bryan A. Plummer
papers.affiliations: Boston University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab
papers.intro: 本文提出MoTIF数据集，是首个包含命令可行性标注（不可行原因和后续问题）的移动应用交互式视觉-语言导航数据集，并定义了任务可行性预测新任务和基线模型。

papers.title: Masked-Attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Bowen Cheng; Ishan Misra; Alexander G. Schwing; Alexander Kirillov; Rohit Girdhar
papers.affiliations: Facebook AI Research (FAIR), University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC)
papers.intro: Mask2Former通过引入掩码注意力（masked attention）和多尺度特征循环等改进，首次以单一架构在语义、实例和全景分割上超越所有专门架构，并显著降低训练内存（3倍）和加速收敛。

papers.title: ByteTrack: Multi-Object Tracking by Associating Every Detection Box
papers.authors: Yifu Zhang, Peize Sun, Yi Jiang, Dongdong Yu, Fucheng Weng, Zehuan Yuan, Ping Luo, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
papers.tags: tracking, object detection, video segmentation, YOLO, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学（Huazhong University of Science and Technology）、香港大学（The University of Hong Kong）、字节跳动（ByteDance Inc.）
papers.intro: ByteTrack提出了一种简单而通用的数据关联方法BYTE，通过两阶段匹配策略关联几乎所有检测框（包括低分框），从而恢复被遮挡目标并过滤背景，在MOT17上首次达到80.3 MOTA，同时保持30 FPS的实时速度。

papers.title: CoANet: Connectivity Attention Network for Road Extraction from Satellite Imagery
papers.authors: Jie Mei; Rou-Jing Li; Wang Gao; Ming-Ming Cheng
papers.affiliations: J. Mei and M.-M. Cheng are with the TKLNDST, College of Computer Science, Nankai University; R.-J. Li is with the State Key Laboratory of Earth Surface Processes and Resource Ecology, Faculty of Geographical Science, Beijing Normal University; W. Gao is with Science and Technology on Complex System Control and Intelligent Agent Cooperation Laboratory
papers.intro: 提出CoANet（连接性注意力网络），通过联合学习道路分割与邻域像素连接性，并利用条带卷积提取线性特征，在SpaceNet和DeepGlobe上取得最优性能。

papers.title: VideoCLIP: Contrastive Pre-training for Zero-shot Video-Text Understanding
papers.authors: Hu Xu, Gargi Ghosh, Po-Yao Huang, Dmytro Okhonko, Armen Aghajanyan, Florian Metze, Luke Zettlemoyer, Christoph Feichtenhofer
papers.affiliations: Facebook AI; Carnegie Mellon University
papers.intro: VideoCLIP 提出一种对比学习视频-文本预训练框架，通过“时间重叠正样本”和“检索增强的难负样本”两类技术，使模型在多个零样本视频-文本理解任务上达到最先进性能，甚至在部分任务上超越全监督方法。

papers.title: UNetFormer: A UNet-like Transformer for Efficient Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Urban Scene Imagery
papers.authors: Libo Wang, Rui Li, Ce Zhang, Shenghui Fang, Chenxi Duan, Xiaoliang Meng, Peter M. Atkinson
papers.affiliations: 1. 武汉大学遥感信息工程学院，2. 自然资源部华南热带亚热带自然资源监测重点实验室，3. 兰卡斯特大学兰卡斯特环境中心，4. 英国生态与水文中心，5. 特温特大学地理信息科学和地球观测学院，6. 南安普顿大学地理与环境科学学院，7. 中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所
papers.intro: 本文提出一种UNet-like Transformer（UNetFormer），采用轻量级CNN编码器和基于Transformer的解码器，通过高效的全局-局部注意力机制同时建模全局和局部上下文，在保持高推理速度的同时实现了先进的语义分割精度。

papers.title: ActionCLIP: A New Paradigm for Video Action Recognition
papers.authors: Mengmeng Wang, Jiazheng Xing, Yong Liu
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University
papers.intro: ActionCLIP将视频动作识别重新建模为视频-文本匹配的多模态学习问题，提出了“预训练-提示-微调”（pre-train, prompt and fine-tune）的新范式，通过复用CLIP预训练模型、设计文本和视觉提示并端到端微调，在通用动作识别和零样本/少样本迁移上均取得领先性能。

papers.title: Change is Everywhere: Single-Temporal Supervised Object Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.authors: Zhuo Zheng, Ailong Ma, Liangpei Zhang, Yanfei Zhong
papers.affiliations: Wuhan University
papers.intro: 本文提出单时相监督学习（STAR）范式，通过利用未配对单时相图像的语义标签构造伪双时相图像对作为监督信号，结合时间对称归纳偏置和可重用语义分割架构的ChangeStar变化检测器，实现了仅使用单时相标注即可训练高精度变化检测模型并泛化到真实双时相图像。

papers.title: Screen2Words: Automatic Mobile UI Summarization with Multimodal Learning
papers.authors: Bryan Wang, Gang Li, Xin Zhou, Zhourong Chen, Tovi Grossman, Yang Li
papers.affiliations: University of Toronto, Google Research
papers.intro: Screen2Words提出了一个多模态学习方法，利用大规模人工标注数据集自动生成移动UI屏幕的简洁语言摘要，并通过实验验证了其有效性和优越性。

papers.title: QVHighlights: Detecting Moments and Highlights in Videos via Natural Language Queries
papers.authors: Jie Lei, Tamara L. Berg, Mohit Bansal
papers.affiliations: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
papers.intro: 本文提出QVHighlights数据集和Moment-DETR基线模型，将视频时刻检索与精彩片段检测统一为一个基于自然语言查询的端到端集合预测问题。

papers.title: AndroidEnv: A Reinforcement Learning Platform for Android
papers.authors: Daniel Toyama, Philippe Hamel, Anita Gergely, Gheorghe Comanici, Amelia Glaese, Zafarali Ahmed, Tyler Jackson, Shibl Mourad, Doina Precup
papers.affiliations: DeepMind
papers.intro: AndroidEnv是一个基于Android操作系统的开源强化学习平台，通过统一的触摸屏接口提供真实设备级交互，支持在大量真实应用中定义任务，并允许代理直接部署到物理设备。

papers.title: CLIP4Clip: An Empirical Study of CLIP for End to End Video Clip Retrieval
papers.authors: Huaishao Luo, Lei Ji, Ming Zhong, Yang Chen, Wen Lei, Nan Duan, Tianrui Li
papers.affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University; Microsoft Research Asia; Microsoft STCA
papers.intro: 论文提出CLIP4Clip模型，基于预训练CLIP通过端到端微调和多种相似度计算机制，将图像-文本知识高效迁移到视频-文本检索，并在多个基准数据集上达到SOTA。

papers.title: Frozen in Time: A Joint Video and Image Encoder for End-to-End Retrieval
papers.authors: Max Bain, Arsha Nagrani, Gül Varol, Andrew Zisserman
papers.affiliations: Visual Geometry Group, University of Oxford; LIGM, École des Ponts, Univ Gustave Eiffel, CNRS (Gül Varol)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于空间-时间Transformer的双编码器模型，将图像视为“冻结在时间中”的单帧视频，通过课程学习联合图像和视频文本数据集进行端到端训练，并贡献了新的视频-文本预训练数据集WebVid-2M，在多个视频检索基准上取得最先进结果。

papers.title: Grounding Open-Domain Instructions to Automate Web Support Tasks
papers.authors: Nancy Xu, Sam Masling, Michael Du, Giovanni Campagna, Larry Heck, James Landay, Monica S Lam
papers.affiliations: Stanford University; Viv Labs, Samsung Research
papers.intro: 本文提出RUSS系统，通过设计领域特定语言ThingTalk将开放域自然语言指令解析为形式化动作，并利用语义解析器和网页元素定位模型，实现高准确率的Web任务自动化。

papers.title: Exploring Cross-Image Pixel Contrast for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Wenguan Wang, Tianfei Zhou, Fisher Yu, Jifeng Dai, Ender Konukoglu, Luc Van Gool
papers.affiliations: Computer Vision Lab, ETH Zurich; SenseTime Research
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于像素级对比学习的有监督语义分割方法，通过跨图像像素间和像素-区域间的对比损失，显式地学习结构化更优的像素嵌入空间，从而提升分割性能。

papers.title: WebSRC: A Dataset for Web-Based Structural Reading Comprehension
papers.authors: Xingyu Chen, Zihan Zhao, Lu Chen, Danyang Zhang, Jiabao Ji, Ao Luo, Yuxuan Xiong, Kai Yu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, OCR, gui
papers.affiliations: X-LANCE Lab, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, MoE Key Lab of Artificial Intelligence, AI Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China; State Key Lab of Media Convergence Production Technology and Systems, Beijing, China
papers.intro: 本文提出了WebSRC，一个大规模、多模态的网页结构阅读理解数据集，包含400K问答对和6.4K网页片段（含HTML、截图和元数据），旨在推动机器对网页空间结构和逻辑结构的综合理解。

papers.title: Mapping Natural Language Instructions to Mobile UI Action Sequences
papers.authors: Yang Li, Jiacong He, Xin Zhou, Yuan Zhang, Jason Baldridge
papers.affiliations: Google Research, Mountain View, CA, 94043
papers.intro: 提出一个将自然语言指令拆解为动作短语并接地到移动UI对象上的两阶段模型（动作短语提取 + 接地），并构建三个新数据集，在PIXELHELP上取得70.59%完全匹配准确率。

papers.title: Span-based Localizing Network for Natural Language Video Localization
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Aixin Sun, Wei Jing, Joey Tianyi Zhou
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore; Institute of High Performance Computing, A*STAR, Singapore; Institute for Infocomm Research, A*STAR, Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出将自然语言视频定位任务重新建模为基于跨度的问答（span-based QA）任务，并设计了一个视频跨度定位网络VSLNet，通过查询引导的高亮策略有效解决了视频与文本之间的差异，在三个基准数据集上取得了最优性能。

papers.title: YOLOv4: Optimal Speed and Accuracy of Object Detection
papers.authors: Alexey Bochkovskiy, Chien-Yao Wang, Hong-Yuan Mark Liao
papers.affiliations: Alexey Bochkovskiy（未公开所属机构）；Chien-Yao Wang 和 Hong-Yuan Mark Liao 均来自 Institute of Information Science, Academia Sinica, Taiwan
papers.intro: YOLOv4 通过系统组合多种 Bag-of-Freebies 和 Bag-of-Specials 模块（包括 WRC、CSP、CmBN、SAT、Mish、Mosaic、DropBlock、CIoU 等），在单 GPU 训练条件下实现了速度和精度的最优平衡，在 COCO 数据集上达到 43.5% A…

papers.title: Learning 2D Temporal Adjacent Networks for Moment Localization with Natural Language
papers.authors: Songyang Zhang, Houwen Peng, Jianlong Fu, Jiebo Luo
papers.affiliations: University of Rochester; Microsoft Research
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于二维时间图（2D Temporal Map）的单阶段框架 2D-TAN，通过显式建模视频时刻候选之间的时间相邻关系，实现更精准的自然语言时刻定位。

papers.title: Searching for MobileNetV3
papers.authors: Andrew Howard, Mark Sandler, Grace Chu, Liang-Chieh Chen, Bo Chen, Mingxing Tan, Weijun Wang, Yukun Zhu, Ruoming Pang, Vijay Vasudevan, Quoc V. Le, Hartwig Adam
papers.affiliations: Google AI, Google Brain
papers.intro: 本文通过结合平台感知的神经网络架构搜索（NAS）与NetAdapt算法，并引入h-swish激活函数、重新设计昂贵层以及轻量级分割解码器LR-ASPP，提出了MobileNetV3系列模型，在分类、检测和分割任务上实现了最优的精度-延迟平衡。

papers.title: Anomaly Locality in Video Surveillance
papers.authors: Federico Landi, Cees G. M. Snoek, Rita Cucchiara
papers.affiliations: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, University of Amsterdam
papers.intro: 论文提出一种基于时空管（spatiotemporal tubes）的异常检测方法，构建了首个训练和测试集均带边界框监督的异常检测数据集UCFCrime2Local，实验证明利用局部性可使模型性能大幅提升，且对定位误差鲁棒并能自动生成弱监督时空提议。

papers.title: YOLOv3: An Incremental Improvement
papers.authors: Joseph Redmon, Ali Farhadi
papers.affiliations: University of Washington
papers.intro: YOLOv3通过多尺度预测（类似FPN）、更深的Darknet-53骨干网络、以及用逻辑回归替代softmax进行多标签分类，在保持实时速度（22-51ms）的同时大幅提升了精度，AP50达到57.9%，与RetinaNet相当且速度快3.8倍。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration
papers.authors: Evan Zheran Liu, Kelvin Guu, Panupong Pasupat, Tianlin Shi, Percy Liang
papers.affiliations: †Department of Computer Science, ‡Department of Statistics, Stanford University
papers.intro: 本文提出工作流引导探索（Workflow-Guided Exploration, WGE）框架，通过从示范中提取高层工作流来约束智能体的探索动作，结合一个新的神经策略网络DOMNET，在多个网页交互任务上实现了超越先前方法的样本效率和成功率。

papers.title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
papers.authors: Mark Sandler, Andrew Howard, Menglong Zhu, Andrey Zhmoginov, Liang-Chieh Chen
papers.affiliations: Google Inc
papers.intro: 提出MobileNetV2，通过倒残差结构和线性瓶颈层，在保持低计算量的同时大幅提升移动端模型的识别精度，并推广到目标检测和语义分割任务。

papers.title: Real-world Anomaly Detection in Surveillance Videos
papers.authors: Waqas Sultani, Chen Chen, Mubarak Shah
papers.affiliations: 1Department of Computer Science, Information Technology University, Pakistan; 2Center for Research in Computer Vision (CRCV), University of Central Florida (UCF)
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于深度多实例排序（Deep MIL Ranking）的弱监督视频异常检测方法，仅利用视频级标签（正常/异常）训练模型，并在新构建的大规模真实世界监控视频数据集上取得了显著优于现有方法的效果。

papers.title: World of Bits: An Open-Domain Platform for Web-Based Agents
papers.authors: Tianlin (Tim) Shi, Andrej Karpathy, Linxi (Jim) Fan, Jonathan Hernandez, Percy Liang
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, OpenAI
papers.intro: 本文提出World of Bits（WoB）平台，利用互联网作为开放域强化学习环境，结合缓存技术、众包任务创建以及行为克隆与强化学习实现智能体训练。

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.authors: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Lukasz Kaiser, Illia Polosukhin
papers.affiliations: Google Brain, Google Research, University of Toronto
papers.intro: 本文提出Transformer架构，完全基于注意力机制（摒弃循环和卷积），实现了在机器翻译任务上更优的质量、更强的并行性和更短的训练时间。

papers.title: MobileNets: Efficient Convolutional Neural Networks for Mobile Vision Applications
papers.authors: Andrew G. Howard, Menglong Zhu, Bo Chen, Dmitry Kalenichenko, Weijun Wang, Tobias Weyand, Marco Andreetto, Hartwig Adam
papers.affiliations: Google Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于深度可分离卷积的轻量级神经网络架构MobileNet，并通过两个超参数（宽度乘子和分辨率乘子）允许用户在延迟和准确率之间灵活权衡，在ImageNet分类及多项视觉任务上实现了高效性能。

papers.title: YOLO9000: Better, Faster, Stronger
papers.authors: Joseph Redmon, Ali Farhadi
papers.affiliations: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
papers.intro: 提出YOLOv2（改进的实时检测器）和YOLO9000（能检测超过9000类物体的系统），通过联合训练检测和分类数据，实现在实时速度下大幅扩展检测类别，并刷新多项基准精度记录。

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.authors: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, Jian Sun
papers.affiliations: Microsoft Research
papers.intro: 提出残差学习框架，通过引入恒等快捷连接，使网络能够轻松训练超过100层甚至上千层，并在ImageNet分类、COCO检测等多项任务上取得创纪录结果。

papers.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
papers.authors: Joseph Redmon, Santosh Divvala, Ross Girshick, Ali Farhadi
papers.affiliations: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Facebook AI Research
papers.intro: YOLO将目标检测重新定义为回归问题，使用单一卷积网络直接预测整张图像中所有物体的边界框和类别概率，实现了实时且统一的检测。

papers.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.authors: Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, Geoffrey E. Hinton
papers.affiliations: University of Toronto
papers.intro: 本文训练了一个包含5个卷积层和3个全连接层的深度卷积神经网络（AlexNet），在ImageNet上以远优于先前最佳方法的top-5错误率（15.3%）赢得了ILSVRC-2012竞赛，并引入了ReLU、GPU并行、局部响应归一化、重叠池化和Dropout等关键技术。
